CL:0001069.definition: An innate lymphoid cell that is capable of producing T-helper 2-cell associated cytokines upon stimulation.
CL:0001069.label: group 2 innate lymphoid cell

CL:0001071.definition: An innate lymphoid cell that constituitively expresses RORgt and is capable of expressing IL17A and/or IL-22.
CL:0001071.label: group 3 innate lymphoid cell

CL:0001072.definition: An innate lymphoid cell in the human with the phenotype CD34-negative, CD117-positive, and a precusor to NK cells, ILC2 cells, and ILC3 cells.
CL:0001072.label: CD34-negative, CD117-positive innate lymphoid cell, human

CL:0001078.definition: A group 3 innate lymphoid cell in the human with the phenotype IL-7Ralpha-positive.
CL:0001078.label: group 3 innate lymphoid cell, human

CL:0001082.definition: An innate lyphoid cell with an immature phenotype.
CL:0001082.label: immature innate lymphoid cell

CL:0001087.definition: A CD4-positive, alpha beta memory T cell with the phenotype CD45RA-positive, CD45RO-negative, and CCR7-negative.
CL:0001087.label: effector memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell, terminally differentiated

CL:0001200.definition: A lymphocyte of B lineage that is CD19-positive.
CL:0001200.label: lymphocyte of B lineage, CD19-positive

CL:0001201.definition: A B cell that is CD19-positive.
CL:0001201.label: B cell, CD19-positive

CL:0001203.definition: A CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell with memory phenotype indicated by being CD45RO and CD127-positive. This cell type is also described as being CD25-negative.
CL:0001203.label: CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell, CD45RO-positive

CL:0001204.definition: CD4-positive, alpha-beta long-lived T cell with the phenotype CD45RO-positive and CD127-positive. This cell type is also described as being CD25-negative.
CL:0001204.label: CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell, CD45RO-positive

CL:0002010.definition: A lin-negative, MHC-II-negative, CD11c-positive, FLT3-positive cell with intermediate expression of SIRP-alpha.
CL:0002010.label: pre-conventional dendritic cell

CL:0002028.definition: A cell type that can give rise to basophil and mast cells. This cell is CD34-positive, CD117-positive, CD125-positive, FceRIa-negative, and T1/ST2-negative, and expresses Gata-1, Gata-2, C/EBPa
CL:0002028.label: basophil mast progenitor cell

CL:0002031.definition: A hematopoietic progenitor cell that is capable of developing into only one lineage of hematopoietic cells.
CL:0002031.label: hematopoietic lineage restricted progenitor cell

CL:0002032.definition: A hematopoietic oligopotent progenitor cell that has the ability to differentiate into limited cell types but lacks lineage cell markers and self renewal capabilities.
CL:0002032.label: hematopoietic oligopotent progenitor cell

CL:0002038.definition: A CD4-positive, CXCR5-positive, CCR7-negative alpha-beta T cell located in follicles of secondary lymph nodes that is BCL6-high, ICOS-high and PD1-high, and stimulates follicular B cells to undergo class-switching and antibody production.
CL:0002038.label: T follicular helper cell

CL:0002045.definition: A pro-B cell that is CD45R/B220-positive, CD43-positive, HSA-low, BP-1-negative and Ly6c-negative. This cell type is also described as being lin-negative, AA4-positive, Kit-positive, IL7Ra-positive and CD45R-positive.
CL:0002045.label: fraction A pre-pro B cell

CL:0002048.definition: A pre-B cell precursor is CD19-low, CD22-positive , CD34-positive, CD38-positive.
CL:0002048.label: late pro-B cell

CL:0002057.definition: A classical monocyte that is CD14-positive, CD16-negative, CD64-positive, CD163-positive.
CL:0002057.label: CD14-positive, CD16-negative classical monocyte

CL:0002062.definition: A squamous pulmonary alveolar epithelial cell that is flattened and branched. A pulmonary alveolar type 1 cell covers more than 98% of the alveolar surface. This large cell has thin (50-100 nm) cytoplasmic extensions to form the air-blood barrier essential for normal gas exchange.
CL:0002062.label: pulmonary alveolar type 1 cell

CL:0002063.definition: A pulmonary alveolar epithelial cell that modulates the fluid surrounding the alveolar epithelium by secreting and recycling surfactants via specialized organelles called alveolar lamellar bodies. This cell type also contributes to tissue repair and can differentiate after injury into a pulmonary alveolar type 1 cell. This cuboidal cell is thicker than squamous alveolar cells, has a rounded apical surface that projects above the level of the surrounding epithelium, and its free surface is covered by short microvilli.
CL:0002063.label: pulmonary alveolar type 2 cell

CL:0002064.definition: A secretory cell found in pancreatic acini that secretes digestive enzymes and mucins. This cell is a typical zymogenic cell, have a basal nucleus and basophilic cytoplasm consisting of regular arrays of granular endoplasmic reticulum with mitochondria and dense secretory granules.
CL:0002064.label: pancreatic acinar cell

CL:0002067.definition: An enteroendocrine cell that produces glucagon.
CL:0002067.label: type A enteroendocrine cell

CL:0002071.definition: A columnar absorptive epithelial cell found in the epithelium of large intestine, specialized for water and electrolyte absorption. Unlike small intestinal enterocytes, those in the large intestine have fewer apical microvilli.
CL:0002071.label: enterocyte of epithelium of large intestine

CL:0002075.definition: A rare type of columnar epithelial cell that is part of the tracheobronchial epithelium. This cell is characterized by a distinctive tuft of apical microvilli, which extends into the cytoplasm, and a pear-shaped morphology, broad at the base and tapering to a narrow apex. It plays vital roles in chemosensation, producing cytokines like IL-25, and enhancing mucociliary clearance through acetylcholine release to support mucus movement and airway defense.
CL:0002075.label: brush cell of tracheobronchial tree

CL:0002076.definition: An epithelial cell derived from endoderm.
CL:0002076.label: endo-epithelial cell

CL:0002077.definition: An epithelial cell derived from ectoderm.
CL:0002077.label: ecto-epithelial cell

CL:0002078.definition: Epithelial cell derived from mesoderm or mesenchyme.
CL:0002078.label: meso-epithelial cell

CL:0002079.definition: Epithelial cell found in the ducts of the pancreas. This cell type contributes to the high luminal pH.
CL:0002079.label: pancreatic ductal cell

CL:0002088.definition: This is a cell found in the gastrointestinal tract of mammals and serves as a pacemaker that triggers gut contraction. ICCs mediate inputs from the enteric nervous system to smooth muscle cells and are thought to be the cells from which gastrointestinal stromal tumors (GISTs) arise.
CL:0002088.label: interstitial cell of Cajal

CL:0002092.definition: A cell found in the bone marrow. This can include fibroblasts, macrophages, adipocytes, osteoblasts, osteoclasts, endothelial cells and hematopoietic cells.
CL:0002092.label: bone marrow cell

CL:0002097.definition: A cell of the adrenal cortex. Cell types include those that synthesize and secrete chemical derivatives (steroids) of cholesterol.
CL:0002097.label: cortical cell of adrenal gland

CL:0002098.definition: A cardiac myocyte that is connected to other cardiac myocytes by transverse intercalated discs (GO:0014704) at a regular interval.
CL:0002098.label: regular cardiac myocyte

CL:0002117.definition: A class switched memory B cell that lacks IgG on the cell surface.
CL:0002117.label: IgG-negative class switched memory B cell

CL:0002129.definition: Regular cardiac myocyte of a cardiac atrium.
CL:0002129.label: regular atrial cardiac myocyte

CL:0002131.definition: Regular cardiac myocyte of a cardiac ventricle.
CL:0002131.label: regular ventricular cardiac myocyte

CL:0002132.definition: A stomal cell of the ovary
CL:0002132.label: stromal cell of ovary

CL:0002138.definition: A endothelial cell of a lymphatic vessel. The border of the oak leaf-shaped endothelial cell of initial lymphatics are joined by specialized buttons. The discontinuous feature of buttons distinguishes them from zippers in collecting lymphatics, but both types of junctions are composed of proteins typical of adherens junctions and tight junctions found in the endothelium of blood vessels. Buttons seal the sides of flaps of the oak leaf-shaped endothelial cell, leaving open the tips of flaps as routes for fluid entry without disassembly and reformation of intercellular junctions.
CL:0002138.label: endothelial cell of lymphatic vessel

CL:0002139.definition: An endothelial cell of the vascular tree, which includes blood vessels and lymphatic vessels.
CL:0002139.label: endothelial cell of vascular tree

CL:0002144.definition: An endothelial cell found in capillaries.
CL:0002144.label: capillary endothelial cell

CL:0002145.definition: A multi-ciliated epithelial cell located in the trachea and bronchi, characterized by a columnar shape and motile cilia on its apical surface. These cilia facilitate mucociliary clearance by moving mucus and trapped particles toward the pharynx.
CL:0002145.label: multiciliated columnar cell of tracheobronchial tree

CL:0002149.definition: An epithelial cell of the uterus. This cell has a mesodermal origin.
CL:0002149.label: epithelial cell of uterus

CL:0002159.definition: Epithelial cells derived from general body ectoderm and ectoderm placodes.
CL:0002159.label: general ecto-epithelial cell

CL:0002174.definition: A cell within the follicle of an ovary.
CL:0002174.label: follicular cell of ovary

CL:0002178.definition: An epithelial cell found in the lining of the stomach.
CL:0002178.label: epithelial cell of stomach

CL:0002179.definition: A simple columnar cell that populates the entire luminal surface including the gastric pits. This cell types secrete mucus to form a thick protective, lubricant layer over the gastric wall.
CL:0002179.label: foveolar cell of stomach

CL:0002180.definition: An epithelial cell of the stomach. This cell produces mucous.
CL:0002180.label: mucous cell of stomach

CL:0002181.definition: A columnar epithelial mucous secreting cell located in the neck of the gastric glands. These cells have numerous apical secretory vesicles containing mucins and a basally displaced nucleus. The mucous they secrete is distinct histochemically from that of the surface mucous cells of stomach.
CL:0002181.label: mucous neck cell of gastric gland

CL:0002187.definition: A mitotically active, columnar-shaped keratinocyte located in the stratum basale of the epidermis and attached to the basement membrane. This cell exhibits heterogeneity, encompassing stem and progenitor subpopulations with distinct molecular and proliferative characteristics (Haensel et al., 2020), and serves as the primary source of new keratinocytes for epidermal renewal, homeostasis, and regeneration.
CL:0002187.label: basal cell of epidermis

CL:0002188.definition: An endothelial cell that is part of the glomerulus of the kidney. This cell is flattened, highly fenestrated, and plays a vital role in the formation of glomerular ultrafiltrate.
CL:0002188.label: glomerular endothelial cell

CL:0002191.definition: A cell involved in the formation of a granulocyte.
CL:0002191.label: granulocytopoietic cell

CL:0002193.definition: A cell type that is the first of the maturation stages of the granulocytic leukocytes normally found in the bone marrow. Granules are seen in the cytoplasm. The nuclear material of the myelocyte is denser than that of the myeloblast but lacks a definable membrane. The cell is flat and contains increasing numbers of granules as maturation progresses.
CL:0002193.label: myelocyte

CL:0002194.definition: A cell involved in the formation of a monocyte (monopoiesis).
CL:0002194.label: monopoietic cell

CL:0002201.definition: A renal intercalated cell that secretes base and reabsorbs acid in the distal segments of the kidney tubule to maintain acid/base balance.
CL:0002201.label: renal beta-intercalated cell

CL:0002202.definition: An epithelial cell of the tracheobronchial tree.
CL:0002202.label: epithelial cell of tracheobronchial tree

CL:0002203.definition: A tuft cell that is part of the epithelium of large intestine.
CL:0002203.label: tuft cell of large intestine

CL:0002204.definition: An epithelial cell found in various organs, including the gastrointestinal and respiratory tracts, characterized by a tuft of 120-140 blunt microvilli on its apical surface. This cell exhibits diverse functions depending on its location, which includes chemosensation, initiation of immune responses, contribution to mucociliary clearance, and defense against parasites.
CL:0002204.label: tuft cell

CL:0002210.definition: A slow muscle cell that contains high levels of myoglobin and oxygen storing proteins giving the cell a red appearance.
CL:0002210.label: red muscle cell

CL:0002211.definition: A slow muscle cell that has large amounts of myoglobin, stores energy as triglycerides, generates ATP by the oxidative method and is resistant to fatigue.
CL:0002211.label: type I muscle cell

CL:0002212.definition: A fast muscle fiber cell that stores energy in the form of glycogen and creatine phosphate.
CL:0002212.label: type II muscle cell

CL:0002222.definition: A cell comprising the transparent, biconvex body separating the posterior chamber and vitreous body, and constituting part of the refracting mechanism of the mammalian eye.
CL:0002222.label: vertebrate lens cell

CL:0002223.definition: A cell of the transparent layer of simple cuboidal epithelium over the anterior surface of the lens; transform into lens fiber(s).
CL:0002223.label: anterior lens cell

CL:0002224.definition: A cell of the cuboidal epithelium that covers the lens. The cells of the lens epithelium regulate most of the homeostatic functions of the lens. As ions, nutrients, and liquid enter the lens from the aqueous humor, Na+/K+ ATPase pumps in the lens epithelial cells pump ions out of the lens to maintain appropriate lens osmolarity and volume, with equatorially positioned lens epithelium cells contributing most to this current. The activity of the Na+/K+ ATPases keeps water and current flowing through the lens from the poles and exiting through the equatorial regions. The cells of the lens epithelium also serve as the progenitors for new lens fibers. It constantly lays down fibers in the embryo, fetus, infant, and adult, and continues to lay down fibers for lifelong growth.
CL:0002224.label: lens epithelial cell

CL:0002225.definition: A lens fiber cell that develops from primary lens fiber; located towards the center of lens; cell organelles are normally degraded or in the process of being degraded.
CL:0002225.label: secondary lens fiber

CL:0002231.definition: An epithelial cell of the prostate.
CL:0002231.label: epithelial cell of prostate

CL:0002236.definition: A cell that constitutes the basal layer of epithelium in the prostatic duct.
CL:0002236.label: basal epithelial cell of prostatic duct

CL:0002241.definition: A fibroblasts found in interstitial spaces in the pulmonary tract. Greater numbers of these cells are found in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.
CL:0002241.label: pulmonary interstitial fibroblast

CL:0002242.definition: A cell containing at least one nucleus.
CL:0002242.label: nucleate cell

CL:0002243.definition: A circular smooth muscle cell of the iris, innervated by the ciliary nerves (parasympathetic), and acting to contract the pupil. This muscle cell derives from neuroectoderm. This smooth muscle cell results from transformation of epithelial cells to smooth muscle cells.
CL:0002243.label: smooth muscle cell of sphincter of pupil

CL:0002248.definition: A pluripotent stem cell has the ability to form cells from all three germ layers (ectoderm, mesoderm, and endoderm). However, unlike totipotent stem cells, they cell can not generate all the cells of the whole organism such as placenta.
CL:0002248.label: pluripotent stem cell

CL:0002250.definition: A stem cell located in epithelium the based of the crypt of Lieberkuhn. Division of these cells serve both to maintain the stem cell population and produce the transit amplifying cells that are all precursors of all cell types that populate the intestinal epithelium.
CL:0002250.label: intestinal crypt stem cell

CL:0002251.definition: An epithelial cell of the musculomembranous digestive tube extending from the mouth to the anus.
CL:0002251.label: epithelial cell of alimentary canal

CL:0002252.definition: An epithelial cell of the lining of the esophagus.
CL:0002252.label: epithelial cell of esophagus

CL:0002253.definition: An epithelial cell of the lining of the large intestine.
CL:0002253.label: epithelial cell of large intestine

CL:0002254.definition: An epithelial cell of the lining of the small intestine.
CL:0002254.label: epithelial cell of small intestine

CL:0002257.definition: An epithelial cell of thyroid gland.
CL:0002257.label: epithelial cell of thyroid gland

CL:0002258.definition: An epithelial cell that is part of the thyroid follicle epithelium, with a shape that ranges from squamous when inactive to cuboidal or columnar when active, reflecting its hormonal activity. Its apical surface is lined with microvilli projecting into the colloid-filled lumen, where it synthesizes, stores, and secretes the thyroid hormones thyroxine (T4) and triiodothyronine (T3), releasing them into the bloodstream in response to thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH).
CL:0002258.label: thyroid follicular cell

CL:0002259.definition: The stem cell from which glial precursor cell arises from.
CL:0002259.label: neuroepithelial stem cell

CL:0002262.definition: An endothelial cell that lines any of the venous cavities through which blood passes in various glands and organs such as the spleen and liver.
CL:0002262.label: endothelial cell of sinusoid

CL:0002274.definition: A cell type that secretes histamine.
CL:0002274.label: histamine secreting cell

CL:0002275.definition: A PP cell located in the islets of the pancreas.
CL:0002275.label: pancreatic PP cell

CL:0002293.definition: An epithelial cell of the thymus. Epithelial reticular cells are pleomorphic, stellate, non-phagocytic cells which seem to be supportive in function and are held together by desmosomes. They replace the fibroblastoid reticular cells found in other lymphoid organs. Other epithelial cells in the medulla have the ultrastructure of secretory cells. Although different epithelial cells throughout the thymus appear alike by light microscopy their ultrastructure and function varies.
CL:0002293.label: epithelial cell of thymus

CL:0002303.definition: A cell that is part of pigmented ciliary epithelium. This cell type uptakes sodium and chloride ions from stromal interstitium and passes the ions to non-pigmented ciliary epithelial cells via gap junctions.
CL:0002303.label: pigmented ciliary epithelial cell

CL:0002304.definition: A cell that is part of non-pigmented ciliary epithelium. This cell type participates in aqueous humor formation by releasing solute, principally sodium and chloride ions received from pigmented epithelial cells via gap junctions, into the aqueous humor of the eye.
CL:0002304.label: non-pigmented ciliary epithelial cell

CL:0002305.definition: An epithelial cell of the distal convoluted tubule of the kidney that helps regulate systemic levels of potassium, sodium, calcium, and pH.
CL:0002305.label: epithelial cell of distal tubule

CL:0002306.definition: An epithelial cell of the proximal tubule of the kidney.
CL:0002306.label: epithelial cell of proximal tubule

CL:0002307.definition: A brush border epithelial cell located in the proximal tubule of the kidney, essential for reabsorbing substances like glucose and amino acids from the glomerular filtrate. These cells also secrete organic ions, playing a crucial role in maintaining kidney homeostasis, including electrolyte and acid-base balance, and excreting metabolic waste.
CL:0002307.label: brush border cell of the proximal tubule

CL:0002319.definition: A cell that is part of the nervous system.
CL:0002319.label: neural cell

CL:0002320.definition: A cell of the supporting or framework tissue of the body, which includes adipose tissue, cartilage, and bone. In vertebrates, this cell arises chiefly from the embryonic mesoderm and, in cranial regions, from neural crest.
CL:0002320.label: connective tissue cell

CL:0002324.definition: A myoepithelial cell that is part of a mammary gland and is located in the basal layer. During lactation, a basal-myoepithelial cell of mammary gland contracts under the stimulation of oxytocin. In humans, a basal-myoepithelial cell of mammary gland can be identified by high levels of CD49f and low levels of EpCAM.
CL:0002324.label: basal-myoepithelial cell of mammary gland

CL:0002325.definition: A milk-producing glandular epithelial cell that is part of a mammary gland alveolus and differentiates from a luminal adaptive secretory precursor cell during secretory differentiation (also termed lactogenesis I). Following secretory activation (also termed lactogenesis II), a lactocyte is involved in the synthesis and/or transport of milk constituents including proteins, oligosaccharides, lactose, micronutrients, fat, hormones, immunoglobulins, and cytokines into the lumen of the lactating mammary gland.
CL:0002325.label: lactocyte

CL:0002326.definition: A mammary epithelial cell that occurs in the lumen of the ductal and alveoli structure in the breast.
CL:0002326.label: luminal epithelial cell of mammary gland

CL:0002327.definition: An epithelial cell of the mammary gland.
CL:0002327.label: mammary gland epithelial cell

CL:0002328.definition: An epithelial cell of the bronchus.
CL:0002328.label: bronchial epithelial cell

CL:0002329.definition: An epithelial cell type that lacks the columnar shape typical for other respiratory epithelial cells. This cell type is able to differentiate into other respiratory epithelial cells in response to injury.
CL:0002329.label: basal epithelial cell of tracheobronchial tree

CL:0002334.definition: An undifferentiated fibroblast that can be stimulated to form a fat cell.
CL:0002334.label: preadipocyte

CL:0002340.definition: The exocrine cell of the prostate, this epithelial cell secretes prostatic acid phosphotase and PSA, and is dependent on androgen hormones for survival.
CL:0002340.label: luminal cell of prostate epithelium

CL:0002341.definition: An undifferentiated cell of the prostate epithelium that lacks secretory activity.
CL:0002341.label: basal cell of prostate epithelium

CL:0002343.definition: A natural killer cell subset that is found in the decidual of the uterus and is CD56-high, Galectin-1-positive and CD16-negative. This cell type represents the most abundant immune cell type in the decidual during the first trimester of pregnancy.
CL:0002343.label: decidual natural killer cell, human

CL:0002350.definition: An endothelial cell that lines the intracavitary lumen of the heart, separating the circulating blood from the underlying myocardium. This cell type releases a number of vasoactive substances including prostacyclin, nitrous oxide and endothelin.
CL:0002350.label: endocardial cell

CL:0002355.definition: A large nucleated basophilic erythrocyte found in mammalian embryos. This cell type arises from the blood islands of yolk sacs and expresses different types of hemoglobins (beta-H1, gamma-1 and zeta) than adult erythrocytes. Considered a type of erythroblast as this cell type can enucleate in circulation.
CL:0002355.label: primitive red blood cell

CL:0002362.definition: A cell located in the outermost proliferative zone of the external germinal layer that can differentiate into astroglial cells and granule cells. This cell type is glial fibrillary acidic protein-positive and HNK1-positive.
CL:0002362.label: cerebellar granule cell precursor

CL:0002363.definition: A keratocyte is a specialized fibroblast residing in the cornea stroma that has a flattened, dendritic morphology; located between the lamellae with a large flattened nucleus, and lengthy processes which communicate with neighboring cells. This corneal layer, representing about 85-90% of corneal thickness, is built up from highly regular collagenous lamellae and extracellular matrix components. Keratocytes play the major role in keeping it transparent, healing its wounds, and synthesizing its components. This cell type secretes collagen I, V, VI, and keratan sulfate.
CL:0002363.label: keratocyte

CL:0002364.definition: An epithelial cell of the cortical portion of the thymus. Epithelial cells in this region are required for positive selection of CD8-positive T cells.
CL:0002364.label: cortical thymic epithelial cell

CL:0002365.definition: An epithelial cell of the medullary thymus. This cell type expresses a diverse range of tissue-specific antigens. This promiscuous gene expression is a cell-autonomous property of medullary epithelial cells and is maintained during the entire period of thymic T cell output.
CL:0002365.label: medullary thymic epithelial cell

CL:0002367.definition: An ocular connective tissue cell that is part of the eye's trabecular meshwork and is directly responsible for regulating the outflow of aqueous humor from the anterior chamber of the eye, thereby maintaining proper intraocular pressure.
CL:0002367.label: trabecular meshwork cell

CL:0002368.definition: An epithelial cell of the respiratory tract epithelium.  These cells have an endodermal origin.
CL:0002368.label: respiratory tract epithelial cell

CL:0002370.definition: A simple columnar epithelial cell that secretes mucin. Rough endoplasmic reticulum, mitochondria, the nucleus, and other organelles are concentrated in the basal portion. The apical plasma membrane projects microvilli to increase surface area for secretion.
CL:0002370.label: respiratory tract goblet cell

CL:0002372.definition: A transversely striated, multinucleated syncytial muscle cell, formed by the fusion of myoblasts during muscle development.
CL:0002372.label: myotube

CL:0002376.definition: A glial cell that ensheaths multiple small diameter axons in the peripheral nervous system. The non-myelinating Schwann cell is embedded among neurons (axons) with minimal extracellular spaces separating them from nerve cell membranes and has a basal lamina. Cells can survive without an axon present. These cells can de-differentiate into immature Schwann cells.
CL:0002376.label: non-myelinating Schwann cell

CL:0002393.definition: A monocyte that has characteristics of both patrolling and inflammatory monocytes.
CL:0002393.label: intermediate monocyte

CL:0002394.definition: A myeloid dendritic cell found in the blood, lymph nodes, tonsil, bone marrow, and spleen that is CD141-positive (BDCA-3), XCR1-positive, and Clec9A-positive. This cell-type can cross-present antigen to CD8-positive T cells and can produce inteferon-beta.
CL:0002394.label: CD141-positive myeloid dendritic cell

CL:0002396.definition: A patrolling monocyte that is CD14-low and CD16-positive.
CL:0002396.label: CD14-low, CD16-positive monocyte

CL:0002397.definition: A CD14-positive monocyte that is also CD16-positive and CCR2-negative.
CL:0002397.label: CD14-positive, CD16-positive monocyte

CL:0002399.definition: A myeloid dendritic cell that is CD1c-positive.
CL:0002399.label: CD1c-positive myeloid dendritic cell

CL:0002410.definition: A cell that is found in the periacinar space of the exocrine pancreas and in perivascular and periductal regions of the pancreas, and has long cytoplasmic processes that encircle the base of the acinus. Expresses several intermediate filament proteins including vimentin and nestin. Shares many of the characteristics of hepatatic stellate cells, but not stellate cells of the central nervous system. Upon activation, this cell type undergoes morphological and gene expression changes that make the cell suggestive of being a type of myofibroblast.
CL:0002410.label: pancreatic stellate cell

CL:0002417.definition: An immature or mature cell of the first erythroid lineage to arise during embryonic development.
CL:0002417.label: primitive erythroid lineage cell

CL:0002419.definition: A T cell that expresses a T cell receptor complex and has completed T cell selection.
CL:0002419.label: mature T cell

CL:0002420.definition: A T cell that has not completed T cell selection.
CL:0002420.label: immature T cell

CL:0002453.definition: A proliferative and migratory glial progenitor cell that derives from a neural stem cell and resides within the central nervous system. It possesses the capacity to differentiate into a committed oligodendrocyte progenitor (COP) through a well-defined series of maturation steps, ultimately giving rise to a myelinating oligodendrocyte (MOL). In mice and humans, it is characterized by the expression of specific molecular markers, including Pdgfra, Cspg4 (also known as NG2) and Olig2.
CL:0002453.label: oligodendrocyte precursor cell

CL:0002480.definition: A goblet cell located in the nasal epithelium.
CL:0002480.label: nasal mucosa goblet cell

CL:0002489.definition: A thymocyte that lacks expression of CD4 and CD8.
CL:0002489.label: double negative thymocyte

CL:0002494.definition: A cell located in the heart, including both muscle and non muscle cells.
CL:0002494.label: cardiocyte

CL:0002495.definition: A fetal and neonatal heart cell that undergoes proliferation and is not yet terminally differentiated into a binucleate or a multinucleate cardiac myocyte.
CL:0002495.label: fetal cardiomyocyte

CL:0002496.definition: A tissue-resident lymphocyte located within the epithelial layer of mucosal tissues, particularly within the gastrointestinal, respiratory, and reproductive tracts. Characterised by permanent residency, this cell typically expresses CD103 (integrin alpha-E), which binds to E-cadherin on epithelial cells, enabling epithelial retention in both mice and humans. Phenotypically, IEL displays an activated, antigen-experienced state characterised by the constitutive expression of cytotoxic molecules (granzyme B, perforin) and innate-like receptors (such as NKG2D), enabling rapid, localised surveillance and immediate response to epithelial stress.
CL:0002496.label: intraepithelial lymphocyte

CL:0002503.definition: A cell of the adventitial layer of ductal structures such as the uterer, defent duct, biliary duct, etc
CL:0002503.label: adventitial cell

CL:0002504.definition: A smooth muscle cell of the intestine.
CL:0002504.label: enteric smooth muscle cell

CL:0002518.definition: An epithelial cell of the kidney.
CL:0002518.label: kidney epithelial cell

CL:0002521.definition: An adipocyte that is part of subcutaneous adipose tissue.
CL:0002521.label: subcutaneous adipocyte

CL:0002522.definition: A renal filtration cell is a specialized cell of the renal system that filter fluids by charge, size or both.
CL:0002522.label: renal filtration cell

CL:0002538.definition: An epithelial cell of the intrahepatic portion of the bile duct. These cells are flattened or cuboidal in shape, and have a small nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio relative to large/extrahepatic cholangiocytes.
CL:0002538.label: intrahepatic cholangiocyte

CL:0002543.definition: An endothelial cell that is part of the vein.
CL:0002543.label: vein endothelial cell

CL:0002547.definition: A fibroblast of the aortic adventitia.
CL:0002547.label: fibroblast of the aortic adventitia

CL:0002548.definition: A fibroblast that is part of the heart.
CL:0002548.label: fibroblast of cardiac tissue

CL:0002549.definition: A fibroblast that is part of the choroid plexus.
CL:0002549.label: fibroblast of choroid plexus

CL:0002551.definition: Any skin fibroblast that is part of some dermis.
CL:0002551.label: fibroblast of dermis

CL:0002553.definition: A fibroblast that is part of lung.
CL:0002553.label: fibroblast of lung

CL:0002555.definition: A fibroblast that is part of the mammary gland.
CL:0002555.label: fibroblast of mammary gland

CL:0002559.definition: An animal cell that is part of a hair follicle.
CL:0002559.label: hair follicle cell

CL:0002563.definition: An epithelial cell of the lining of the intestine.
CL:0002563.label: intestinal epithelial cell

CL:0002570.definition: A mesenchymal stem cell of adipose tissue.
CL:0002570.label: mesenchymal stem cell of adipose tissue

CL:0002573.definition: A glial cell that myelinates or ensheathes axons in the peripheral nervous system.
CL:0002573.label: Schwann cell

CL:0002574.definition: A stromal cell of the pancreas.
CL:0002574.label: stromal cell of pancreas

CL:0002584.definition: An epithelial cell of the kidney cortex.
CL:0002584.label: renal cortical epithelial cell

CL:0002585.definition: A blood vessel endothelial cell that is part of the retina.
CL:0002585.label: retinal blood vessel endothelial cell

CL:0002586.definition: An epithelial cell of the retinal pigmented epithelium.
CL:0002586.label: retinal pigment epithelial cell

CL:0002591.definition: A smooth muscle of the pulmonary artery.
CL:0002591.label: smooth muscle cell of the pulmonary artery

CL:0002598.definition: Any smooth muscle cell that is part of some bronchus.
CL:0002598.label: bronchial smooth muscle cell

CL:0002601.definition: A smooth muscle cell of the uterus.
CL:0002601.label: uterine smooth muscle cell

CL:0002604.definition: An astrocyte that is part of the hippocampus.
CL:0002604.label: hippocampal astrocyte

CL:0002605.definition: A transcriptomically distinct astrocyte that is found in the cerebral cortex.
CL:0002605.label: astrocyte of the cerebral cortex

CL:0002608.definition: A neuron with a soma found in the hippocampus.
CL:0002608.label: hippocampal neuron

CL:0002615.definition: An adipocyte that is part of omentum tissue.
CL:0002615.label: adipocyte of omentum tissue

CL:0002617.definition: An adipocyte that is part of the breast.
CL:0002617.label: adipocyte of breast

CL:0002623.definition: An acinar cell that is part of the salivary gland epithelium, responsible for synthesizing and secreting the primary saliva essential for oral digestion, antimicrobial defense, and mucosal immunity. It features apical-basal polarity with apical secretory granules, and tight junctions that maintain polarity and regulate calcium-dependent saliva exocytosis triggered by parasympathetic and sympathetic signals (Ambudkar, 2015). This cell functions in coordination with contractile myoepithelial cells, which aid saliva flow through the ducts into the oral cavity (Khan et al., 2022). In mice and humans, acinar cell development relies on the transcription factor SOX2 (Emmerson et al., 2017), with self-renewal achieved primarily through acinar cell self-duplication and supported by progenitor populations during injury and regeneration (Aure et al., 2016).
CL:0002623.label: acinar cell of salivary gland

CL:0002627.definition: A mature astrocyte that is capable of producing cytokines.
CL:0002627.label: mature astrocyte

CL:0002629.definition: A mature microglial cell that has changed shape to an amoeboid morphology and is capable of cytokine production and antigen presentation.
CL:0002629.label: mature microglial cell

CL:0002631.definition: Any epithelial cell that is part of some upper respiratory tract epithelium.
CL:0002631.label: epithelial cell of upper respiratory tract

CL:0002632.definition: Any epithelial cell that is part of some lower respiratory tract epithelium.
CL:0002632.label: epithelial cell of lower respiratory tract

CL:0002633.definition: A basal cell in the respiratory tract.
CL:0002633.label: respiratory basal cell

CL:0002659.definition: A glandular epithelial cell that is part of the stomach.
CL:0002659.label: glandular epithelial cell of stomach

CL:0002672.definition: A multi-fate stem cell that can give rise to different retinal cell types including rod and cone cells.
CL:0002672.label: retinal progenitor cell

CL:0002677.definition: A regulatory T cell that has not encountered antigen.
CL:0002677.label: naive regulatory T cell

CL:0002678.definition: A CD4-positive, CD25-positive alpha-beta regulatory T cell that has encountered antigen.
CL:0002678.label: memory regulatory T cell

CL:0002681.definition: A cell that is part of a cortex of kidney.
CL:0002681.label: kidney cortical cell

CL:0003050.definition: A cone cell that detects short wavelength light. Exact peak of spectra detected differs between species. In humans, spectra peaks at 420-440 nm.
CL:0003050.label: S cone cell

CL:0004217.definition: A horizontal cell with a large cell body, thick dendrites, and a large dendritic arbor.
CL:0004217.label: H1 horizontal cell

CL:0004218.definition: A horizontal cell with a small cell body, thin dendrites, and small dendritic arbor.
CL:0004218.label: H2 horizontal cell

CL:0004232.definition: An amacrine cell with a flat dendritic arbor and a medium dendritic field. Starburst amacrine cells have post-synaptic terminals in S2. This cell type releases the neurotransmitters gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) and acetylcholine.
CL:0004232.label: starburst amacrine cell

CL:0005006.definition: Specialized epithelial cells involved in the maintenance of osmotic homeostasis. They are characterized by abundant mitochondria and ion transporters. In amniotes, they are present in the renal system. In freshwater fish, ionocytes in the skin and gills help maintain osmotic homeostasis by absorbing salt from the external environment.
CL:0005006.label: ionocyte

CL:0005009.definition: A cuboidal epithelial cell of the kidney which regulates sodium and potassium balance. The activity of sodium and potassium channels on the apical membrane of the cell is regulated by aldosterone and vasopressin. In mammals this cell type is located in the renal collecting duct system.
CL:0005009.label: renal principal cell

CL:0005010.definition: A cuboidal epithelial cell of the kidney that regulates acid/base balance.
CL:0005010.label: renal intercalated cell

CL:0005011.definition: A cuboidal epithelial cell of the kidney which secretes acid and reabsorbs base to regulate acid/base balance.
CL:0005011.label: renal alpha-intercalated cell

CL:0005012.definition: A columnar/cuboidal epithelial cell with multiple motile cilia on its apical surface. These cells facilitate the movement of liquids such as mucus or cerebrospinal fluid across the epithelial surface.
CL:0005012.label: multiciliated epithelial cell

CL:0005018.definition: A cell that secretes ghrelin, the peptide hormone that stimulates hunger.
CL:0005018.label: ghrelin secreting cell

CL:0005019.definition: Ghrelin secreting cells found in the endocrine pancreas.
CL:0005019.label: pancreatic epsilon cell

CL:0005022.definition: Lymphatic progenitor cells, derived from the veins, that give rise to lymphatic endothelial cells.
CL:0005022.label: vascular lymphangioblast

CL:0005026.definition: Multi fate stem cell that gives rise to both hepatocytes and cholangiocytes as descendants. The term often refers to fetal precursors of hepatocytes (differently from 'hepatic stem cell', usually applied to the self-renewing pool of hepatocyte precursors in the adult liver). Hepatoblasts may also be endogenous, as some stem cells found in the liver come from the bone marrow via blood circulation.
CL:0005026.label: hepatoblast

CL:0007001.definition: Cell that has the potential to form a skeletal cell type (e.g. cells in periosteum, cells in marrow) and produce extracellular matrix (often mineralized) and skeletal tissue (often mineralized).
CL:0007001.label: skeletogenic cell

CL:0007011.definition: Neuron that is part of the enteric nervous system.
CL:0007011.label: enteric neuron

CL:0008000.definition: Any muscle cell in which the fibers are not organised into sarcomeres.
CL:0008000.label: non-striated muscle cell

CL:0008001.definition: Any hematopoietic cell that is a precursor of some other hematopoietic cell type.
CL:0008001.label: hematopoietic precursor cell

CL:0008002.definition: A transversely striated, synctial cell of skeletal muscle. It is formed when proliferating myoblasts exit the cell cycle, differentiate and fuse.
CL:0008002.label: skeletal muscle fiber

CL:0008007.definition: A muscle cell that is part of some visceral muscle.
CL:0008007.label: visceral muscle cell

CL:0008011.definition: A skeletal muscle satellite cell that divides by stem cell division.  A proportion of this population undergoes symmetric stem cell division, producing two skeletal muscle satellite stem cells. The rest undergo asymmetric stem cell division - retaining their identity while budding off a daughter cell that differentiates into an adult skeletal muscle myoblast.
CL:0008011.label: skeletal muscle satellite stem cell

CL:0008019.definition: A non-polarised cell precursor cell that is part of some mesenchyme, is associated with the cell matrix but is not connected to other cells and is capable of migration.
CL:0008019.label: mesenchymal cell

CL:0008024.definition: An endocrine cell that is part of the pancreas.
CL:0008024.label: pancreatic endocrine cell

CL:0008028.definition: Any neuron that is capable of part of some visual perception.
CL:0008028.label: visual system neuron

CL:0008031.definition: An interneuron that has its soma located in the cerebral cortex.
CL:0008031.label: cortical interneuron

CL:0008034.definition: Mural cells are pericytes and the vascular smooth muscle cells (vSMCs) of the microcirculation.
CL:0008034.label: mural cell

CL:0008035.definition: Any vascular associated smooth muscle cell that is part of some microcirculatory vessel.
CL:0008035.label: microcirculation associated smooth muscle cell

CL:0008036.definition: A trophoblast cell that is not part of a placental villous.
CL:0008036.label: extravillous trophoblast

CL:0008046.definition: A skeletal muscle fiber that is innervated by alpha motor neuron and generates tension by contracting, thereby allowing for skeletal movement. These fibers make up the large mass of skeletal muscle tissue and are attached to bones by tendons.
CL:0008046.label: extrafusal muscle fiber

CL:0008055.definition: A secretory epithelial cell of the respiratory tract epithelium.  These cells have an endodermal origin.
CL:0008055.label: respiratory tract secretory epithelial cell

CL:0008061.definition: A neuron that releases both gamma-aminobutyric acid and acetylcholine as vesicular neurotransmitters.  Examples include some types of striatal interneuron.
CL:0008061.label: GABA-Chol neuron

CL:0009004.definition: Any cell in the retina, the innermost layer or coating at the back of the eyeball, which is sensitive to light and in which the optic nerve terminates.
CL:0009004.label: retinal cell

CL:0009005.definition: Any cell in a salivary gland.
CL:0009005.label: salivary gland cell

CL:0009006.definition: An enteroendocrine cell that is located in the small intestine.
CL:0009006.label: enteroendocrine cell of small intestine

CL:0009010.definition: Transit-amplifying cells (TACs) are an undifferentiated population in transition between stem cells and differentiated cells.
CL:0009010.label: transit amplifying cell

CL:0009011.definition: A rapidly proliferating population of cells that differentiate from stem cells of the intestinal crypt of the colon. Stem cells located in the crypts of Lieberkühn give rise to proliferating progenitor or transit amplifying cells that differentiate into the four major epithelial cell types. These include columnar absorptive cells or enterocytes, mucous secreting goblet cells, enteroendocrine cells and paneth cells.
CL:0009011.label: transit amplifying cell of colon

CL:0009012.definition: A rapidly proliferating population of cells that differentiate from stem cells of the intestinal crypt of the small intestine. Stem cells located in the crypts of Lieberkühn give rise to proliferating progenitor or transit amplifying cells that differentiate into the four major epithelial cell types. These include columnar absorptive cells or enterocytes, mucous secreting goblet cells, enteroendocrine cells and paneth cells.
CL:0009012.label: transit amplifying cell of small intestine

CL:0009016.definition: An intestinal stem cell that is located in the large intestine crypt of Liberkuhn. These stem cells reside at the bottom of crypts in the large intestine and are highly proliferative. They either differentiate into transit amplifying cells or self-renew to form new stem cells.
CL:0009016.label: intestinal crypt stem cell of large intestine

CL:0009017.definition: An intestinal stem cell that is located in the small intestine crypt of Liberkuhn. These stem cells reside at the bottom of crypts in the small intestine and are highly proliferative. They either differentiate into transit amplifying cells or self-renew to form new stem cells.
CL:0009017.label: intestinal crypt stem cell of small intestine

CL:0009021.definition: A stromal cell found in the lamina propria of the large intestine.
CL:0009021.label: stromal cell of lamina propria of large intestine

CL:0009039.definition: A goblet cell that is located in the colon.
CL:0009039.label: colon goblet cell

CL:0009040.definition: A stromal cell found in the lamina propria of the colon.
CL:0009040.label: stromal cell of lamina propria of colon

CL:0009041.definition: A tuft cell that is part of the colonic epithelium, primarily adapted for microbial sensing in the dense colonic microbiota. Unlike its small intestinal counterpart, it does not participate in parasite-driven tuft cell–ILC2 circuits. Instead, it detects bacterial metabolites via taste-signaling pathways (Strine and Craig, 2022). The colonic tuft cell plays a key role in epithelial repair, modulates inflammatory responses through IL-25 secretion, and contributes to intestinal homeostasis by balancing microbiome interactions (Sebastian et al., 2021).
CL:0009041.label: tuft cell of colon

CL:0009043.definition: An intestinal crypt stem cell that is located in the crypt of Lieberkuhn of colon.
CL:0009043.label: intestinal crypt stem cell of colon

CL:0009051.definition: A T cell that is located in the anorectum.
CL:0009051.label: T cell of anorectum

CL:0009068.definition: An unconventional T lymphocyte population within the thymic medulla that is potentially a thymic resident population.
CL:0009068.label: CD8aa(I) thymocyte

CL:0009070.definition: A thymic epithelial cell located at the corticomedullary junction.
CL:0009070.label: corticomedullary thymic epithelial cell

CL:0009071.definition: A thymic medullary epithelial cell considered to be a pre-AIRE mTEC population.
CL:0009071.label: medullary thymic epithelial cell type 1

CL:0009075.definition: A thymic medullary epithelial cell that expresses muscle-specific biomarkers.
CL:0009075.label: myo-medullary thymic epithelial cell

CL:0009076.definition: A thymic medullary epithelial cell that expresses neuroendocrine biomarkers.
CL:0009076.label: neuro-medullary thymic epithelial cell

CL:0009078.definition: A fibroblast located in the thymic capsule.
CL:0009078.label: thymic fibroblast type 1

CL:0009079.definition: A fibroblast located between thymic lobules.
CL:0009079.label: thymic fibroblast type 2

CL:0009080.definition: A tuft cell located in the small intestine.
CL:0009080.label: tuft cell of small intestine

CL:0009086.definition: An endothelial cell that is part of a respiratory system lymphatic vessel.
CL:0009086.label: endothelial cell of respiratory system lymphatic vessel

CL:0009089.definition: A pericyte cell that is part of a lung.
CL:0009089.label: lung pericyte

CL:0009092.definition: An endothelial cell that is part of a placenta.
CL:0009092.label: endothelial cell of placenta

CL:0009095.definition: An endothelial cell that is part of a uterus.
CL:0009095.label: endothelial cell of uterus

CL:0009099.definition: A progenitor cell that is a tissue-resident mesenchymal cell, important for skeletal muscle regeneration, and able to differentiate into both adipocytes or fibroblasts.
CL:0009099.label: fibro/adipogenic progenitor cell

CL:0009116.definition: A progenitor cell with the potential to differentiate into luminal epithelial cells of mammary glands. In mouse, CD61 and c-kit were found to be coexpressed by the majority of, but not all, committed luminal progenitor cells.
CL:0009116.label: progenitor cell of mammary luminal epithelium

CL:0010006.definition: Any blood vessel endothelial cell that is part of some heart.
CL:0010006.label: cardiac blood vessel endothelial cell

CL:0010008.definition: Any endothelial cell that is part of some heart.
CL:0010008.label: cardiac endothelial cell

CL:0010009.definition: Any photoreceptor cell that is part of some camera-type eye.
CL:0010009.label: camera-type eye photoreceptor cell

CL:0010011.definition: A GABAergic interneuron whose soma is located in the cerebral cortex.
CL:0010011.label: cerebral cortex GABAergic interneuron

CL:0010012.definition: A CNS neuron of the cerebral cortex.
CL:0010012.label: cerebral cortex neuron

CL:0010021.definition: Any myoblast that develops into some cardiac muscle cell.
CL:0010021.label: cardiac myoblast

CL:0010022.definition: A neuron that has its soma in the heart.
CL:0010022.label: cardiac neuron

CL:0011004.definition: A vetebrate lens cell that is any of the elongated, tightly packed cells that make up the bulk of the mature lens in a camera-type eye.
CL:0011004.label: lens fiber cell

CL:0011005.definition: An interneuron that uses GABA as a vesicular neurotransmitter.  These interneurons are inhibitory
CL:0011005.label: GABAergic interneuron

CL:0011010.definition: A cell derived from the mesoderm that is found at the periphery of the embryo.
CL:0011010.label: lateral mesodermal cell

CL:0011011.definition: A cell derived from the mesoderm that is located between the paraxial mesoderm and the lateral plate.
CL:0011011.label: intermediate mesodermal cell

CL:0011012.definition: A cell of the neural crest. Neural crest cells are multipotent. Premigratory neural crest cells are found at the neural plate boarder, some of which will undergo ectomesynchymal transition and delamination to form migratory neural crest cells.
CL:0011012.label: neural crest cell

CL:0011019.definition: A mesothelial cell that is part of the epicardium.
CL:0011019.label: mesothelial cell of epicardium

CL:0011020.definition: An undifferentiated cell derived from a neural stem cell, with a limited capacity to self-renew (Dibajnia and Morshead, 2013) and the ability to generate multiple types of lineage-restricted progenitors, contributing to the formation of neurons, astrocytes, and oligodendrocytes.
CL:0011020.label: neural progenitor cell

CL:0011024.definition: A double negative thymocyte that is CD3-positive, CD4-negative, CD8-negative, that that are present in the periphery in very low numbers and predominantly produce INF-gamma, TNF-alpha, and a low amount of TGF-beta, but not IL-2, IL-4, IL-10 or IL-13 upon activation.
CL:0011024.label: double negative T regulatory cell

CL:0011025.definition: An effector T cell that displays impaired effector functions (e.g., rapid production of effector cytokines, cytotoxicity) and has limited proliferative potential.
CL:0011025.label: exhausted T cell

CL:0011026.definition: A precursor cell that has a tendency to differentiate into a specific type of cell. They are descendants of stem cells, only they are more constrained in their differentiation potential or capacity for self-renewal, and are often more limited in both senses.
CL:0011026.label: progenitor cell

CL:0011027.definition: Any fibroblast that is part of skeletal muscle tissue.
CL:0011027.label: skeletal muscle fibroblast

CL:0011031.definition: A dendritic cell that develops from a monocyte.
CL:0011031.label: monocyte-derived dendritic cell

CL:0011108.definition: Epithelial cell that is part of the colon epithelium.
CL:0011108.label: colon epithelial cell

CL:0011115.definition: A cell that, by division or terminal differentiation, can give rise to other cell types.
CL:0011115.label: precursor cell

CL:0012001.definition: A CNS neuron of the forebrain.
CL:0012001.label: neuron of the forebrain

CL:0013000.definition: Any radial glial cell that is part of some forebrain.
CL:0013000.label: forebrain radial glial cell

CL:0017000.definition: An ionocyte that is part of the lung epithelium. The cells from this type are major sources of the CFTR protein in human and mice.
CL:0017000.label: pulmonary ionocyte

CL:0017001.definition: A mesodermal cell that is part of the splanchnic layer of lateral plate mesoderm.
CL:0017001.label: splanchnic mesodermal cell

CL:0017009.definition: A human dendritic cell that expresses the AXL and SIGLEC6 genes.
CL:0017009.label: Axl+ dendritic cell, human

CL:0019001.definition: Any serous secreting cell that is part of the tracheobronchial epithelium.
CL:0019001.label: tracheobronchial serous cell

CL:0019003.definition: Any goblet cell that is part of the tracheobronchial epithelium.
CL:0019003.label: tracheobronchial goblet cell

CL:0019018.definition: A smooth muscle cell that is part of any blood vessel.
CL:0019018.label: blood vessel smooth muscle cell

CL:0019019.definition: A smooth muscle cell that is part of the tracheobronchial tree.
CL:0019019.label: tracheobronchial smooth muscle cell

CL:0019021.definition: An endothelial cell found in the periportal region hepatic sinusoid, near the portal triad. The fenestrae of these cells are larger but fewer in number compared with those of endothelial cells near the centrilobular region of the hepatic sinusoid.
CL:0019021.label: endothelial cell of periportal hepatic sinusoid

CL:0019022.definition: An endothelial cell found in the centrilobular region hepatic sinusoid, near the central vein. The fenestrae of these cells are smaller but more numerous compared with those of endothelial cells near the periportal region of the hepatic sinusoid.
CL:0019022.label: endothelial cell of pericentral hepatic sinusoid

CL:0019026.definition: Any hepatocyte that is part of the liver lobule periportal region. These cells are primarily involved in oxidative energy metabolism.
CL:0019026.label: periportal region hepatocyte

CL:0019028.definition: Any hepatocyte that is part of the liver lobule midzonal region. These cells have mixed functionality in comparison with those in the other two regions of the liver lobule.
CL:0019028.label: midzonal region hepatocyte

CL:0019029.definition: Any hepatocyte that is part of the liver lobule centrilobular region. These cells are the primary location for the biotransformation of drugs.
CL:0019029.label: centrilobular region hepatocyte

CL:0019031.definition: Goblet cells reside throughout the length of the small and large intestine and are responsible for the production and maintenance of the protective mucus blanket by synthesizing and secreting high-molecular-weight glycoproteins known as mucins. Human intestinal goblet cells secrete the MUC2 mucin, as well as a number of typical mucus components: CLCA1, FCGBP, AGR2, ZG16, and TFF3.
CL:0019031.label: intestine goblet cell

CL:0019032.definition: A tuft cell that is part of the intestinal epithelium, characterized by a distinctive apical tuft and lateral cytospinules connecting to neighbouring cells. This cell senses luminal stimuli via taste receptors and succinate signalling, initiating type 2 immune responses through the secretion of interleukin-25 while modulating epithelial regeneration through prostaglandin synthesis. It expresses key molecular markers such as doublecortin-like kinase 1 (DCLK1) in mice (Hendel et al., 2022), and KIT proto-oncogene in humans (Huang et al., 2024). Developed from intestinal crypt stem cells, this cell requires transcription factor POU2F3 for its development.
CL:0019032.label: intestinal tuft cell

CL:0020029.definition: An epithelial cell that has a cuboidal morphology.
CL:0020029.label: cuboidal epithelial cell

CL:0020030.definition: A CD4-positive alpha-beta T cell that displays impaired function and altered differentiation as a result of chronic antigenic stimulation (e.g., chronic infection, tumors, or persistent inflammation). This state is characterised by sustained expression of PD-1 as a shared feature. Additional exhaustion-associated molecules, including the transcription factor TOX, and context- or stage-dependent changes in markers such as LAG-3, TIM-3, CD39, and T-bet, may also be observed; however, the expression levels of these molecules vary depending on exhaustion stage and tissue environment.
CL:0020030.label: CD4-positive exhausted alpha-beta T cell

CL:0020035.definition: A T cell that is located in the intestinal epithelium and is capable of a mucosal immune response.
CL:0020035.label: intestinal intraepithelial lymphocyte

CL:1000022.definition: Any epithelial cell that is part of some mesonephric nephron tubule.
CL:1000022.label: mesonephric nephron tubule epithelial cell

CL:1000042.definition: Any neuroblast (sensu Vertebrata) that is part of some forebrain.
CL:1000042.label: forebrain neuroblast

CL:1000143.definition: Any goblet cell that is part of some lung epithelium.
CL:1000143.label: lung goblet cell

CL:1000223.definition: A neuroendocrine cell that is part of respiratory epithelium of the lung and is involved in the sensory detection of environmental stimuli, including hypoxia, nicotine and air pressure. Ultrastructurally, this cell type is characterized by the presence of cytoplasmic dense core granules, which are considered the storage sites of amine and peptide hormones. Pulmonary neuroendocrine cells are innervated and appear as solitary cells or as clustered masses, localized at airway bifurcation sites, called neuroepithelial bodies that can release serotonin in response to hypoxia and interact with sensory nerve terminals. Pulmonary neuroendocrine cells also function as reserve stem cells that repair the surrounding epithelium after injury.
CL:1000223.label: pulmonary neuroendocrine cell

CL:1000271.definition: An epithelial cell that is part of the lung epithelium. This cell is characterised by the presence of cilia on its apical surface.
CL:1000271.label: lung multiciliated epithelial cell

CL:1000272.definition: Any secretory cell that is part of some lung.
CL:1000272.label: lung secretory cell

CL:1000296.definition: An epithelial cell that is part of the urethra.
CL:1000296.label: epithelial cell of urethra

CL:1000306.definition: A fibroblast that is part of the tunica adventitia of artery.
CL:1000306.label: fibroblast of tunica adventitia of artery

CL:1000307.definition: A fibroblast that is part of the dense regular elastic tissue.
CL:1000307.label: fibroblast of dense regular elastic tissue

CL:1000309.definition: An adipocyte that is part of the epicardial fat.
CL:1000309.label: epicardial adipocyte

CL:1000320.definition: A goblet cell that is part of the epithelium of large intestine.
CL:1000320.label: large intestine goblet cell

CL:1000329.definition: A goblet cell that is part of the epithelium of trachea.
CL:1000329.label: tracheal goblet cell

CL:1000334.definition: An enterocyte that is part of the epithelium of small intestine.
CL:1000334.label: enterocyte of epithelium of small intestine

CL:1000339.definition: An enterocyte that is part of the epithelium proper of small intestine.
CL:1000339.label: enterocyte of epithelium proper of small intestine

CL:1000340.definition: An enterocyte that is part of the epithelium proper of duodenum.
CL:1000340.label: enterocyte of epithelium proper of duodenum

CL:1000342.definition: An enterocyte that is part of the epithelium proper of ileum.
CL:1000342.label: enterocyte of epithelium proper of ileum

CL:1000343.definition: A paneth cell that is part of the epithelium of small intestine.
CL:1000343.label: paneth cell of epithelium of small intestine

CL:1000347.definition: An enterocyte (absorptive epithelial cell) of the colonic epithelium, characterized by a columnar shape. This cell is responsible for the absorption, transport, and metabolization of short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) produced by gut bacteria, as well as the transport and absorption of water and electrolytes.
CL:1000347.label: colonocyte

CL:1000348.definition: A basal cell that is part of the epithelium of trachea.
CL:1000348.label: basal cell of epithelium of trachea

CL:1000398.definition: An endothelial cell that is part of the hepatic sinusoid. These cells possess flattened areas containing perforations about 0.1 micrometers in diameter, known as fenestrae. The fenestrae are arranged in groups known as sieve plates.
CL:1000398.label: endothelial cell of hepatic sinusoid

CL:1000412.definition: An endothelial cell that is part of the arteriole.
CL:1000412.label: endothelial cell of arteriole

CL:1000413.definition: A blood vessel endothelial cell that is part of an arterial endothelium.
CL:1000413.label: endothelial cell of artery

CL:1000414.definition: An endothelial cell that is part of the venule.
CL:1000414.label: endothelial cell of venule

CL:1000428.definition: A somatic stem cell that is part of the epidermis.
CL:1000428.label: stem cell of epidermis

CL:1000432.definition: An epithelial cell that is part of the conjunctiva.
CL:1000432.label: conjunctival epithelial cell

CL:1000443.definition: A smooth muscle cell that is part of the ciliary body.
CL:1000443.label: ciliary muscle cell

CL:1000449.definition: An epithelial cell that is part of the nephron.
CL:1000449.label: epithelial cell of nephron

CL:1000450.definition: An epithelial cell that is part of the glomerular capsule.
CL:1000450.label: epithelial cell of glomerular capsule

CL:1000452.definition: An epithelial cell that is part of the glomerular parietal epithelium.
CL:1000452.label: parietal epithelial cell

CL:1000453.definition: An epithelial cell that is part of the intermediate tubule.
CL:1000453.label: epithelial cell of intermediate tubule

CL:1000454.definition: An epithelial cell that is part of the collecting duct of renal tubule.
CL:1000454.label: kidney collecting duct epithelial cell

CL:1000486.definition: A basal cell that is part of the urothelium. Compared to other urothelial cell types, a basal cell of the urothelium is positioned along the basement membrane, is the most undifferentiated and serves a progenitor role.
CL:1000486.label: basal cell of urothelium

CL:1000487.definition: A smooth muscle cell that is part of the prostate gland.
CL:1000487.label: smooth muscle cell of prostate

CL:1000488.definition: An epithelial cell that is part of the bile duct. Cholangiocytes contribute to bile secretion via net release of bicarbonate and water. They are cuboidal epithelium in the small interlobular bile ducts, but become columnar and mucus secreting in larger bile ducts approaching the porta hepatis and the extrahepatic ducts.
CL:1000488.label: cholangiocyte

CL:1000494.definition: An epithelial cell that is part of a nephron tubule.
CL:1000494.label: nephron tubule epithelial cell

CL:1000495.definition: A goblet cell that is part of the small intestine.
CL:1000495.label: small intestine goblet cell

CL:1000497.definition: A cell that is part of a kidney.
CL:1000497.label: kidney cell

CL:1000500.definition: A cell that is part of kidney interstitium.
CL:1000500.label: kidney interstitial cell

CL:1000504.definition: A cell that is part of a renal medulla.
CL:1000504.label: kidney medulla cell

CL:1000507.definition: A cell that is part of a nephron tubule.
CL:1000507.label: kidney tubule cell

CL:1000510.definition: Any kidney epithelial cell that is part of some glomerular epithelium.
CL:1000510.label: kidney glomerular epithelial cell

CL:1000600.definition: Any cell that is part of some lower urinary tract.
CL:1000600.label: lower urinary tract cell

CL:1000612.definition: Any renal cortical epithelial cell that is part of some renal corpuscle.
CL:1000612.label: kidney corpuscule cell

CL:1000615.definition: Any kidney tubule cell that is part of some renal cortex tubule.
CL:1000615.label: kidney cortex tubule cell

CL:1000616.definition: Any kidney medulla cell that is part of some outer medulla of kidney.
CL:1000616.label: kidney outer medulla cell

CL:1000617.definition: Any kidney medulla cell that is part of some inner medulla of kidney.
CL:1000617.label: kidney inner medulla cell

CL:1000692.definition: A fibroblast that is part of an interstitial compartment of a kidney.
CL:1000692.label: kidney interstitial fibroblast

CL:1000746.definition: Any kidney corpuscule cell that is part of some renal glomerulus.
CL:1000746.label: glomerular cell

CL:1000768.definition: Any nephron tubule epithelial cell that is part of some renal connecting tubule.
CL:1000768.label: kidney connecting tubule epithelial cell

CL:1000838.definition: Any epithelial cell of proximal tubule that is part of some proximal convoluted tubule and has part some brush border.
CL:1000838.label: kidney proximal convoluted tubule epithelial cell

CL:1000839.definition: Any epithelial cell of proximal tubule that is part of some proximal straight tubule.
CL:1000839.label: kidney proximal straight tubule epithelial cell

CL:1000849.definition: Any epithelial cell of distal tubule that is part of some distal convoluted tubule.
CL:1000849.label: kidney distal convoluted tubule epithelial cell

CL:1000854.definition: A blood vessel cell that is part of a kidney.
CL:1000854.label: kidney blood vessel cell

CL:1000892.definition: An endothelial cell that is part of the capillary of the kidney.
CL:1000892.label: kidney capillary endothelial cell

CL:1000909.definition: Any nephron tubule epithelial cell that is part of some loop of Henle.
CL:1000909.label: kidney loop of Henle epithelial cell

CL:1001016.definition: Any kidney loop of Henle epithelial cell that is part of some ascending limb of loop of Henle.
CL:1001016.label: kidney loop of Henle ascending limb epithelial cell

CL:1001021.definition: Any kidney loop of Henle epithelial cell that is part of some descending limb of loop of Henle.
CL:1001021.label: kidney loop of Henle descending limb epithelial cell

CL:1001036.definition: A cell that is part of a vasa recta.
CL:1001036.label: vasa recta cell

CL:1001106.definition: An epithelial cell that is part of some loop of Henle thick ascending limb. It is known in some mammalian species that this cell may express the Na+-K+-2Cl− cotransporter (NKCC2) apically.
CL:1001106.label: kidney loop of Henle thick ascending limb epithelial cell

CL:1001107.definition: An epithelial cell that is part of some loop of Henle thin ascending limb.
CL:1001107.label: kidney loop of Henle thin ascending limb epithelial cell

CL:1001109.definition: An epithelial cell that is part of some loop of Henle thick ascending limb segment located in the renal cortex.
CL:1001109.label: kidney loop of Henle cortical thick ascending limb epithelial cell

CL:1001111.definition: An epithelial cell that is part of some loop of Henle thin descending limb.
CL:1001111.label: kidney loop of Henle thin descending limb epithelial cell

CL:1001131.definition: A cell that is part of some vasa recta ascending limb.
CL:1001131.label: vasa recta ascending limb cell

CL:1001225.definition: A cell that is part of a collecting duct of renal tubule.
CL:1001225.label: kidney collecting duct cell

CL:1001318.definition: A pericyte cell located in the kidney interstitium.
CL:1001318.label: renal interstitial pericyte

CL:1001319.definition: Any cell that is part of some urinary bladder.
CL:1001319.label: bladder cell

CL:1001320.definition: Any cell that is part of some urethra.
CL:1001320.label: urethra cell

CL:1001428.definition: A urothelial cell that is part of the urothelium of the urinary bladder.
CL:1001428.label: bladder urothelial cell

CL:1001431.definition: Any renal principal cell that is part of some collecting duct of renal tubule.
CL:1001431.label: kidney collecting duct principal cell

CL:1001432.definition: Any renal intercalated cell that is part of some collecting duct of renal tubule.
CL:1001432.label: kidney collecting duct intercalated cell

CL:1001433.definition: An epithelial cell of the exocrine pancreas.
CL:1001433.label: epithelial cell of exocrine pancreas

CL:1001451.definition: A sensory neuron of the dorsal root ganglia that senses body position and sends information about how much the muscle is stretched to the spinal cord.
CL:1001451.label: sensory neuron of dorsal root ganglion

CL:1001474.definition: An inhibitory, GABAergic projection neuron in the striatum that integrates glutamatergic signals arising from the cerebral cortex and thalamus.
CL:1001474.label: medium spiny neuron

CL:1001509.definition: The neurons that utilize glycine as a neurotransmitter.
CL:1001509.label: glycinergic neuron

CL:1001516.definition: The various hormone- or neurotransmitter-secreting cells present throughout the mucosa of the intestinal tract.
CL:1001516.label: intestinal enteroendocrine cell

CL:1001567.definition: Any endothelial cell of vascular tree that is part of some lung.
CL:1001567.label: lung endothelial cell

CL:1001568.definition: Any endothelial cell of vascular tree that is part of some pulmonary artery.
CL:1001568.label: pulmonary artery endothelial cell

CL:1001569.definition: An interneuron with a soma found in the hippocampus.
CL:1001569.label: hippocampal interneuron

CL:1001571.definition: A pyramidal neuron with a soma found in the hippocampus.
CL:1001571.label: hippocampal pyramidal neuron

CL:1001580.definition: A glial cell that is part of the hippocampus.
CL:1001580.label: hippocampal glial cell

CL:1001586.definition: Glandular cell of mammary epithelium. Example: glandular cells of large and intermediate ducts, glandular cells in terminal ducts.
CL:1001586.label: mammary gland glandular cell

CL:1001591.definition: Glandular cell of oviduct epithelium. Example: peg cells, ciliated cells.
CL:1001591.label: oviduct secretory cell

CL:1001596.definition: Glandular cell of salivary gland. Example: Serous cells, mucous cells, cuboidal epithelial cells of the intercalated ducts, simple cuboidal epithelium of the striated ducts, epithelial cells of excretory ducts.
CL:1001596.label: salivary gland glandular cell

CL:1001598.definition: A glandular cell found in the epithelium of the small intestine. Example: Enterocytes, Goblet cells, enteroendocrine cells; Paneth cells; M cells; Somatostatin-secreting Cells (D-cells) .
CL:1001598.label: small intestine secretory cell

CL:1001599.definition: Glandular cell of exocrine pancreas epithelium. Example: pancreatic acinar cell, glandular cells in pancreatic canaliculi, glandular cells in pancreatic ducts.
CL:1001599.label: pancreas exocrine glandular cell

CL:1001601.definition: Hormone secreting cell located in the cortex of adrenal gland. Glandular cells in the adrenal cortex secrete mineralocorticoids, glucocorticoids and androgens.
CL:1001601.label: adrenal gland glandular cell

CL:1001602.definition: A distinct endothelial cell forming the walls of the capillaries within the cerebral cortex.
CL:1001602.label: cerebral cortex endothelial cell

CL:1001603.definition: Circulating macrophages and tissue macrophages (alveolar macrophages) of lung.
CL:1001603.label: lung macrophage

CL:1001610.definition: Hematopoietic cells resident in the bone marrow. Include: hematopoietic stem cells (lymphoid stem cells and myeloid stem cells) and the precursor cells for thrombocytes, erythrocytes, basophils, neutrophils, eosinophils, monocytes and lymphocytes.
CL:1001610.label: bone marrow hematopoietic cell

CL:1100001.definition: An epithelial cell that is specialised for the synthesis and secretion of specific biomolecules.
CL:1100001.label: secretory epithelial cell

CL:2000002.definition: A specialized, enlarged, connective tissue cell of the decidua with enlarged nucleus, dense membrane‐bound secretory granules and cytoplasmic accumulation of glycogen and lipid droplets. These cells develop by the transformation of endometrial stromal cells during decidualization.
CL:2000002.label: decidual cell

CL:2000005.definition: Any macroglial cell that is part of a brain.
CL:2000005.label: brain macroglial cell

CL:2000008.definition: Any blood vessel endothelial cell that is part of a microvascular endothelium.
CL:2000008.label: microvascular endothelial cell

CL:2000016.definition: Any lung endothelial cell that is part of a microvascular endothelium.
CL:2000016.label: lung microvascular endothelial cell

CL:2000028.definition: Any glutamatergic neuron that is part of a cerebellum.
CL:2000028.label: cerebellum glutamatergic neuron

CL:2000029.definition: Any neuron that is part of a central nervous system.
CL:2000029.label: central nervous system neuron

CL:2000030.definition: Any native cell that is part of a hypothalamus.
CL:2000030.label: hypothalamus cell

CL:2000032.definition: A neuron that is part of a peripheral nervous system.
CL:2000032.label: peripheral nervous system neuron

CL:2000042.definition: Any fibroblast that is part of a embryo.
CL:2000042.label: embryonic fibroblast

CL:2000046.definition: Any cardiac muscle cell that is part of a cardiac ventricle.
CL:2000046.label: ventricular cardiac muscle cell

CL:2000047.definition: Any motor neuron that is part of a brainstem.
CL:2000047.label: brainstem motor neuron

CL:2000049.definition: Any pyramidal cell that is part of a primary motor cortex.
CL:2000049.label: primary motor cortex pyramidal cell

CL:2000054.definition: A large, granular, liver specific natural killer cell that adheres to the endothelial cells of the hepatic sinusoid.
CL:2000054.label: hepatic pit cell

CL:2000055.definition: Any dendritic cell that is part of a liver.
CL:2000055.label: liver dendritic cell

CL:2000059.definition: Any microvascular endothelial cell that is part of a prostate gland.
CL:2000059.label: prostate gland microvascular endothelial cell

CL:2000060.definition: A trophoblast of placental villi.  These cells fuse to form synctial  trophoplast - the placental side of the interface between the placenta and maternal blood sinusoids in the decidua.
CL:2000060.label: placental villous trophoblast

CL:2000092.definition: Any keratinocyte that is part of a hair follicle.
CL:2000092.label: hair follicular keratinocyte

CL:2000093.definition: Any fibroblast of lung that is part of a bronchus.
CL:2000093.label: bronchus fibroblast of lung

CL:2000097.definition: Any dopaminergic neuron that is part of a midbrain.
CL:2000097.label: midbrain dopaminergic neuron

CL:3000001.definition: A tissue-resident macrophage that is part of the placenta. A Hofbauer cell expresses high levels of growth factors and metalloproteinases that support vasculogenesis, angiogenesis, branching morphogenesis and tissue remodeling. A Hofbauer cell has a fetal origin, is found in the villous stroma, chorion, and amnion, and is present throughout pregnancy.
CL:3000001.label: Hofbauer cell

CL:3000004.definition: A neuron type that is located in a peripheral nervous system and it transmits sensory information from the peripheral (PNS) to the central nervous system (CNS). A sensory neuron converts physical (light, sound, touch) or chemical (such as taste and smell) stimuli into an electrical signal through a process known as sensory transduction. The function of a sensory neuron is to carry informations from the external environment and internal body conditions to the central nervous system for further processing.
CL:3000004.label: peripheral sensory neuron

CL:4006000.definition: A fibroblast that is part of the breast.
CL:4006000.label: fibroblast of breast

CL:4023008.definition: A glutamatergic neuron located in the cerebral cortex that projects to structures of telencephalic origins.
CL:4023008.label: intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic cortical neuron

CL:4023009.definition: A glutamatergic neuron located in the cerebral cortex that projects to structures not derived from telencephalon.
CL:4023009.label: extratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic cortical neuron

CL:4023011.definition: A transcriptomically distinct GABAergic neuron located in the cerebral cortex that expresses Lamp5.
CL:4023011.label: lamp5 GABAergic interneuron

CL:4023012.definition: A glutamatergic neuron located in the cerebral cortex that projects axons locally rather than distantly.
CL:4023012.label: near-projecting glutamatergic cortical neuron

CL:4023013.definition: A glutamatergic neuron located in the cerebral cortex that projects to the thalamus.
CL:4023013.label: corticothalamic-projecting glutamatergic cortical neuron

CL:4023015.definition: A transcriptomically distinct GABAergic neuron located in the cerebral cortex that expresses Gamma-synuclein.
CL:4023015.label: sncg GABAergic interneuron

CL:4023016.definition: A transcriptomically distinct GABAergic neuron derived from the CGE and that expresses the vasoactive intestinal polypeptide. Its soma is located in the forebrain.
CL:4023016.label: VIP GABAergic interneuron

CL:4023017.definition: A transcriptomically distinct GABAergic neuron located in the cerebral cortex that expresses somatostatin (sst) and derived from the MGE.
CL:4023017.label: sst GABAergic interneuron

CL:4023018.definition: A transcriptomically distinct GABAergic interneuron with a soma located in the pallium. These neurons express Parvalbumin.
CL:4023018.label: pvalb GABAergic interneuron

CL:4023026.definition: A GABAergic medium spiny neuron located in the striatum that gives rise to the direct basal ganglia pathway. It projects directly to the GPi and SNr, where it inhibits tonically active GABAergic output neurons to disinhibit thalamic and brainstem motor targets (Gerfen. 2023). In mice and humans, this cell selectively expresses the D1 dopamine receptor (DRD1), which couples to stimulatory G-proteins (Gs/Gαolf) to increase cAMP and activate PKA-dependent signaling cascades (Gerfen et al., 1990; Kebabian & Calne, 1979). Functionally, activation of this cell promotes selected motor actions by disinhibiting thalamic and midbrain motor centers (Mink, 1996; Cui et al., 2013).
CL:4023026.label: direct pathway medium spiny neuron

CL:4023029.definition: A GABAergic medium spiny neuron located in the striatum that gives rise to the indirect basal ganglia pathway. It projects to the GPe, where its axon typically ramifies in two regions but does not extend beyond this nucleus (Gerfen et al., 2022). It selectively expresses the D2 dopamine receptor (DRD2), which couples to inhibitory G-proteins (Gi/o) to decrease cAMP and suppress PKA-mediated signaling (Gerfen et al., 2022). Morphologically, this cell displays fewer and shorter dendrites than the MSN-D1 and receives fewer glutamatergic inputs, yet it exhibits significantly higher intrinsic excitability (Gertler et al., 2022). Functionally, activation of this cell suppresses competing or alternative motor actions by inhibiting GPe neurons, leading through STN and other GPe circuits to increased GPi/SNr output and stronger inhibition of thalamic and brainstem targets (Mink, 1996; Tecuapetla et al., 2016).
CL:4023029.label: indirect pathway medium spiny neuron

CL:4023033.definition: A retinal ganglion cell that is depolarized by decreased illumination of their receptive field center.
CL:4023033.label: OFF retinal ganglion cell

CL:4023035.definition: A neuron that is derived from a precursor cell in the lateral ganglion eminence.
CL:4023035.label: lateral ganglionic eminence derived neuron

CL:4023036.definition: A transcriptomically distinct pvalb GABAergic interneuron located in the pallium. It is recognizable by the straight terminal axonal 'cartridges' of vertically oriented strings of synaptic boutons. Chandelier PV cells' boutons target exclusively the axon initial segment (AIS) of pyramidal cells, with a single cell innervating hundreds of pyramidal cells in a clustered manner.  These cells are fast-spiking.
