CL:4023036.label: pvalb chandelier GABAergic interneuron

CL:4023038.definition: A glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in cortical layer 6b. They are transcriptomically related to corticothalamic-projecting neurons but have differential projections to the thalamus or anterior cingulate.
CL:4023038.label: L6b glutamatergic cortical neuron

CL:4023040.definition: An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in cortical layers L2/3-6.
CL:4023040.label: L2/3-6 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron

CL:4023041.definition: A transcriptomically distinct glutamatergic neuron, with a soma found in the deeper portion of L5, that has long-range axonal projections including deep subcortical targets outside of the telencephalon and, in some cases, the spinal cord. While the L5 ET neuron projections are not limited to ET targets, they are clearly differentiated from the neuron subclasses whose projections are constrained to intratelencephalic (IT) targets. L5 ET neurons are generally the largest excitatory cortical neurons, typically having a thick apical dendrite with a prominent dendritic tuft in layer 1 and displaying burst-firing physiological characteristics.
CL:4023041.label: L5 extratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic cortical neuron

CL:4023042.definition: A transcriptomically distinct corticothalamic-projecting neuron with a soma found in cortical layer 6.
CL:4023042.label: L6 corticothalamic-projecting glutamatergic cortical neuron

CL:4023043.definition: A transcriptomically distinct near-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in layer 5/6 of the primary motor cortex. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: Deep layer (non-IT) excitatory neurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', cluster L5/6 NP.
CL:4023043.label: L5/6 near-projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex

CL:4023046.definition: An excitatory glutamatergic neuron transcriptomically related to the CT subclass, with a soma preferentially located in the bottom of L6 of the primary motor cortex.
CL:4023046.label: L6b glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex

CL:4023050.definition: An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in L6 of the primary motor cortex. These cells are short untufted pyramidal cells, which could be stellate or inverted.
CL:4023050.label: L6 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex

CL:4023051.definition: A transcriptomically distinct type of mesothelial fibroblast that is derived from the neural crest, is localized on blood vessels, and is a key component of the pia and arachnoid membranes surrounding the brain. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: Non-neuronal cells', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', clusters VLMC.
CL:4023051.label: vascular leptomeningeal cell

CL:4023054.definition: A mesothelial cell that has undergone mesothelial-to-mesenchymal transition (MMT) to become a fibroblast cell.
CL:4023054.label: mesothelial fibroblast

CL:4023058.definition: A mesothelial fibroblast found in the leptomeninx.
CL:4023058.label: mesothelial fibroblast of the leptomeninx

CL:4023059.definition: An oligodendrocyte precursor cell that is committed to differentiate.
CL:4023059.label: committed oligodendrocyte precursor

CL:4023063.definition: An interneuron that is derived from the medial ganglionic eminence. In mice and humans, it expresses LHX6 and SOX6.
CL:4023063.label: medial ganglionic eminence derived interneuron

CL:4023064.definition: An interneuron that is derived from the caudal ganglionic eminence.
CL:4023064.label: caudal ganglionic eminence derived interneuron

CL:4023069.definition: A GABAergic interneuron that develops from the medial ganglionic eminence and has migrated to the cerebral cortex.
CL:4023069.label: medial ganglionic eminence derived GABAergic interneuron

CL:4023072.definition: A cell that is part of the brain vasculature.
CL:4023072.label: brain vascular cell

CL:4023095.definition: A pyramidal neuron which lacks a clear tuft formation but extends to large radial distances.
CL:4023095.label: untufted pyramidal neuron

CL:4023111.definition: A pyramidal neuron with soma located in the cerebral cortex.
CL:4023111.label: cerebral cortex pyramidal neuron

CL:4023154.definition: A glial cell that myelinates axonal processes.
CL:4023154.label: myelinating glial cell

CL:4023161.definition: An excitatory glutamatergic interneuron found in the granular layer of the cerebellar cortex and also in the granule cell domain of the cochlear nucleus. Unipolar brush cells have a round or oval cell body with usually a single short dendrite that ends in a brush-like tuft of short dendrites unique to them known as dendrioles.
CL:4023161.label: unipolar brush cell

CL:4023168.definition: A neuron that is part of the somatic sensory system. Somatosensory neurons innervate the skin or integument to detect different types of thermal, chemical, and mechanical touch stimuli.
CL:4023168.label: somatosensory neuron

CL:4023188.definition: A retinal ganglion cell that originate in the ganglion cell layer of the retina, and project to the parvocellular layers of the lateral geniculate nucleus (LGN). These cells are known as midget retinal ganglion cells due to the small sizes of their dendritic trees and cell bodies.
CL:4023188.label: midget ganglion cell of retina

CL:4023189.definition: A retinal ganglion cell located in the ganglion cell layer of the retina. This cell projects to magnocellular cells in the lateral geniculate nucleus (LGN). They have large cell bodies and extensive, branching dendritic networks that contribute to their large receptive fields.
CL:4023189.label: parasol ganglion cell of retina

CL:4028001.definition: Any capillary endothelial cell that is part of a lung.
CL:4028001.label: pulmonary capillary endothelial cell

CL:4028002.definition: An alveolar capillary endothelial cell that is located distally to alveolar capillary type 2 endothelial cells.
CL:4028002.label: alveolar capillary type 1 endothelial cell

CL:4028003.definition: An alveolar capillary endothelial cell that is located proximally to alveolar capillary type 1 endothelial cells and in close apposition to alveolar type 1 epithelial cells (also known as type I pneumocytes).
CL:4028003.label: alveolar capillary type 2 endothelial cell

CL:4028004.definition: A pulmonary interstitial fibroblast that is part of the alveolus and contains lipid droplets.
CL:4028004.label: alveolar type 1 fibroblast cell

CL:4028006.definition: A pulmonary interstitial fibroblast that is part of the alveolus and localizes to vascular adventitia.
CL:4028006.label: alveolar adventitial fibroblast

CL:4030001.definition: A stromal cell that is part of the thymus.
CL:4030001.label: stromal cell of thymus

CL:4030002.definition: An alpha-beta memory T cell with the phenotype CD45RA-positive.
CL:4030002.label: effector memory CD45RA-positive, alpha-beta T cell, terminally differentiated

CL:4030006.definition: An epithelial cell that is part of the fallopian tube that secretes mucus and oviduct-specific products in response to hormonal stimulation from estrogen and luteinizing hormone. This fallopian tube secretory cell is similar in height to the ciliated cell, but typically exhibits a more narrow, columnar shape. Its nucleus is ovoid and oriented perpendicular to the cell's long axis, with denser chromatin and a smaller nucleolus compared to the ciliated cell.
CL:4030006.label: fallopian tube secretory epithelial cell

CL:4030011.definition: A brush border cell that is part of segment 3 (S3) of the proximal tubule epithelium, which extends from the medullary rays of the renal cortex into the outer medulla.
CL:4030011.label: epithelial cell of proximal tubule segment 3

CL:4030015.definition: A renal alpha-intercalated cell that is part of the collecting duct of the renal tubule.
CL:4030015.label: kidney collecting duct alpha-intercalated cell

CL:4030016.definition: An epithelial cell located in the early distal convoluted tubule.
CL:4030016.label: epithelial cell of early distal convoluted tubule

CL:4030018.definition: A renal principal cell located in the connecting tubule.
CL:4030018.label: kidney connecting tubule principal cell

CL:4030023.definition: A hillock cell that is located in respiratory epithelium. In some mammalian species, this cell type has been noted to express KRT13 and KRT4 and is postulated to play a role in squamous barrier function and immunomodulation.
CL:4030023.label: respiratory tract hillock cell

CL:4030024.definition: An epithelial, transitional cell type between basal and secretory; located in stratified, non-ciliated structures (called hillocks) with high cell turnover in epithelium. In some mammalian species, this cell type has been noted to express KRT13 and is postulated to play a role in squamous barrier function and immunomodulation.
CL:4030024.label: hillock cell

CL:4030026.definition: An enterocyte of the human intestine expressing bestrophin-4 (BEST4) calcium-activated ion channels.
CL:4030026.label: BEST4+ enterocyte

CL:4030027.definition: An amacrine cell that uses GABA as a neurotransmitter.
CL:4030027.label: GABAergic amacrine cell

CL:4030028.definition: An amacrine cell that uses glycine as a neurotransmitter.
CL:4030028.label: glycinergic amacrine cell

CL:4030031.definition: Any cell that is located within the interstitium between the cells most prominent in defining a given tissue. \"Interstitial cell\" is a morphological term and refers to a variety of cells with differing origins and phenotypes.
CL:4030031.label: interstitial cell

CL:4030034.definition: A multiciliated epithelial cell located in the respiratory tract epithelium, characterized by a columnar shape and motile cilia on its apical surface. This cell develops through a highly orchestrated process, transitioning from a basal progenitor via an intermediate deuterosomal cell stage that generates centrioles essential for ciliogenesis.
CL:4030034.label: respiratory tract multiciliated cell

CL:4030055.definition: A urothelial cell that is part of the regenerative layer(s) of cells directly superficial to basal cells in urothelium. The layer of intermediate cells in the urothelium ranges from one to several layers thick depending on the species with intermediate cells attached to adjacent cell layers and one another via desmosomes.
CL:4030055.label: intermediate cell of urothelium

CL:4030056.definition: A urothelial cell that is terminally differentiated and part of the urothelial apical surface that forms the high-resistance barrier of urothelium. Umbrella cells have been described as the largest of urothelial cell types, highly polarized, and, in some species, multinucleated. In the relaxed state, these cells form a dome-shaped structure at the apical pole and can also cover multiple underlying intermediate cells, leading to the name umbrella cells. In contrast, these cells flatten when the bladder is filled.
CL:4030056.label: umbrella cell of urothelium

CL:4030059.definition: A transcriptomically distinct intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found between cortical layer 2-4. This intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron has thin-tufted apical dendrites and extends its axonal projection into L5 in the neocortex. This neuronal type has a hyperpolarised resting membrane potential.
CL:4030059.label: L2/3 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron

CL:4030062.definition: An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic with a soma located in cortical layer 4/5.
CL:4030062.label: L4/5 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron

CL:4030063.definition: A transcriptomically distinct intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in cortical layer 3-4. This neuron type can have a pyramidal, star-pyramidal or spiny stellate morphology and projects its output to L2/3 and L5A/B.
CL:4030063.label: L4 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron

CL:4030064.definition: An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in cortical layer 5.
CL:4030064.label: L5 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron

CL:4030065.definition: A transcriptomically distinct intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in L6 of the primary motor cortex. These cells are short untufted pyramidal cells, which could be stellate or inverted.
CL:4030065.label: L6 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron

CL:4030067.definition: A transcriptomically defined near-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in cortical layer 5/6.
CL:4030067.label: L5/6 near-projecting glutamatergic neuron

CL:4033005.definition: A(n) serous secreting cell that is part of a(n) bronchus submucosal gland.
CL:4033005.label: serous secreting cell of bronchus submucosal gland

CL:4033008.definition: A(n) vein endothelial cell that is part of a(n) respiratory system.
CL:4033008.label: vein endothelial cell of respiratory system

CL:4033010.definition: A(n) neuroendocrine cell that is part of a(n) epithelium of lobar bronchus.
CL:4033010.label: neuroendocrine cell of epithelium of lobar bronchus

CL:4033013.definition: A keratinocyte that resides in the epidermal suprabasal layer and expresses differentiation markers, including keratin 1 and keratin 10, in both humans and mice. In human interfollicular epidermis, this cell retains proliferative capacity and possesses retrodifferentiation potential, acquiring basal-like properties during wound healing or basement membrane contact.
CL:4033013.label: suprabasal keratinocyte

CL:4033014.definition: A small, narrow, peg-shaped epithelial cell with little cytoplasm that is part of oviduct epithelium. This cell is rarer than the ciliated and secretory epithelial cells of the fallopian tube epithelium and is often found intercalated between them. Peg cells are generally distributed basally along the epithelium and have been found in high concentrations at the fimbriated, distal end of the fallopian tube in humans. It may have a regenerative/stem-cell function. In humans, markers include EPCAM, CD44, and ITGA6.
CL:4033014.label: peg cell

CL:4033015.definition: A star-shaped glial cell that is part of some retina. This cell links neurons to blood vessels and may provide structural and physiological support to optic nerve head axons.
CL:4033015.label: retinal astrocyte

CL:4033016.definition: A myofibroblast that is part of an alveoli during alveolarization. The contractile force of this cell elongates the secondary crest, while producing a framework of elastin and tenascin. During the maturation of the septa, secondary crest myofibroblasts, together with matrix fibroblasts, secrete metalloproteinases and other ECM‐remodeling proteins to thin the septal tip ECM. The secondary crest myofibroblast continues producing elastin, eventually undergoing apoptosis during adulthood.
CL:4033016.label: secondary crest myofibroblast

CL:4033019.definition: An ON bipolar cell type with dendrites selectively contacting S-cones.
CL:4033019.label: ON-blue cone bipolar cell

CL:4033027.definition: An OFF diffuse bipolar cell that makes synaptic contact with both L/M and S-cone photoreceptors and only minimal contact with rod photoreceptors.
CL:4033027.label: diffuse bipolar 1 cell

CL:4033028.definition: An OFF diffuse bipolar cell that predominantly connects to ON parasol cells and lateral amacrine cells. This cell contains a large number of synaptic ribbons and a small axon arbor area.
CL:4033028.label: diffuse bipolar 2 cell

CL:4033029.definition: An OFF calbindin-positive bipolar cell that has a large dendritic field and stratifies narrowly close to the middle of the inner plexiform layer. Its axon terminal is characterized by regularly branching and varicose processes resembling beads on a string. Most of DB3a contacts with cones are triad-associated.
CL:4033029.label: diffuse bipolar 3a cell

CL:4033030.definition: An OFF calbindin-negative bipolar cell that has a large dendritic field and stratifies narrowly close to the middle of the inner plexiform layer. Its axon terminal is characterized by regularly branching and varicose processes resembling beads on a string. Most of DB3b contacts with cones are non-triad-associated.
CL:4033030.label: diffuse bipolar 3b cell

CL:4033031.definition: An ON diffuse bipolar cell that predominantly connects to ON parasol cells and lateral amacrine cells.
CL:4033031.label: diffuse bipolar 4 cell

CL:4033032.definition: An ON diffuse bipolar cell that has a large dendritic field and large axon terminals, which show little or no overlap. This cell predominantly connects to narrow thorny ganglion cells.
CL:4033032.label: diffuse bipolar 6 cell

CL:4033033.definition: An OFF bipolar cell with a small dendritic tree that provides most of the triad-associated basal (flat) contacts at cone pedicles.
CL:4033033.label: flat midget bipolar cell

CL:4033034.definition: An ON bipolar cell with a small dendritic tree that forms most of the central (invaginating) elements opposite the synaptic ribbon at the cone triad.
CL:4033034.label: invaginating midget bipolar cell

CL:4033035.definition: An ON bipolar cell that has large dendritic and axonal fields.
CL:4033035.label: giant bipolar cell

CL:4033036.definition: An OFF bipolar cell that is fovea-specific and expresses FEZF1, NXPH1 and NXPH2.
CL:4033036.label: OFFx cell

CL:4033037.definition: A mucus secreting cell of a submucosal gland of the tracheobronchial tree.
CL:4033037.label: mucus secreting cell of tracheobronchial tree submucosal gland

CL:4033039.definition: An alpha-beta CD8 T cell that resides in the lung.
CL:4033039.label: lung resident memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell

CL:4033043.definition: A macrophage that is part of the lung connective tissue (pulmonary interstitium). This cell performs tissue remodeling and contributes to barrier immunity through antigen presentation.
CL:4033043.label: lung interstitial macrophage

CL:4033046.definition: A midget ganglion cell that depolarizes in response to increased light intensity in the center of its receptive field. The majority of input that this cell receives comes from invaginating midget bipolar cells.
CL:4033046.label: ON midget ganglion cell

CL:4033047.definition: A midget ganglion cell that depolarizes in response to decreased light intensity in the center of its receptive field. The majority of input that this cell receives comes from flat midget bipolar cells.
CL:4033047.label: OFF midget ganglion cell

CL:4033048.definition: A respiratory epithelial cell derived from a basal cell, with a topographic nuclear position between the basal and luminal cells of the airway epithelium. This non-basal, intermediate progenitor cell has limited proliferative capacity and can differentiate into multiciliated, secretory, or rare airway cells (ionocytes, tuft cells, neuroendocrine cells). It shares some ultrastructural features with basal cells but lacks the defined characteristics of fully differentiated cellular phenotypes.
CL:4033048.label: respiratory tract suprabasal cell

CL:4033050.definition: A neuron that releases catecholamine as a neurotransmitter.
CL:4033050.label: catecholaminergic neuron

CL:4033051.definition: A parasol ganglion cell that depolarizes in response to decreased light intensity in the center of its receptive field. The majority of input that this cell receives comes from DB3a bipolar cells.
CL:4033051.label: OFF parasol ganglion cell

CL:4033052.definition: A parasol ganglion cell that depolarizes in response to increased light intensity in the center of its receptive field. The majority of input that this cell receives comes from DB4 bipolar cells.
CL:4033052.label: ON parasol ganglion cell

CL:4033054.definition: A cell that is adjacent to a vessel. A perivascular cell plays a crucial role in maintaining vascular function and tissue homeostasis. This cell type regulates vessel integrity and flow dynamics.
CL:4033054.label: perivascular cell

CL:4033057.definition: A luminal epithelial cell of the mammary gland that can proliferate and has the potential to differentiate into a lactocyte during pregnancy. In humans, a luminal adaptive secretory precursor cell can be identified by high levels of the markers EpCAM and CD49f, and in mice it can be identified by low levels of CD29 and high levels of CD14, Kit, CD61, and Tspan8.
CL:4033057.label: luminal adaptive secretory precursor cell of mammary gland

CL:4033058.definition: A luminal epithelial cell of the mammary gland that transduces endocrine cues to orchestrate proliferation, architectural remodeling, and differentiation of other cells in the mammary gland via paracrine signaling. This cell expresses high levels of estrogen receptors. In humans, a luminal hormone-sensing cell can be identified by high levels of EpCAM and low levels of CD49f, and in mice it can be identified by low levels of CD29 and high levels of Foxa1, CD133, and Sca1 (Ly6a).
CL:4033058.label: luminal hormone-sensing cell of mammary gland

CL:4033080.definition: A(n) pulmonary alveolar type 2 cell that is cycling.
CL:4033080.label: cycling pulmonary alveolar type 2 cell

CL:4033085.definition: An ON diffuse bipolar cell that stratifies in the stratum 3 of the inner plexiform layer to make synapses with ON parasol ganglion cells. A diffuse bipolar 5 cell has high expression of MYO16 compared with other bipolar cells.
CL:4033085.label: diffuse bipolar 5 cell

CL:4033087.definition: A tissue-resident macrophage that is part of the placenta. This cell helps preventing immunological rejection of the fetus by modulating the immune environment. A placental resident macrophage has high plasticity to adapt to the changing needs of each phase of pregnancy.
CL:4033087.label: placental resident macrophage

CL:4033095.definition: An ON bipolar cell that has high expression of DIRC3, KCNJ3, LINC01915, PTPRK compared with other bipolar cells.
CL:4033095.label: diffuse bipolar 4a cell

CL:4040003.definition: Precursor of type II pneumocyte. These cells do not have lamellar bodies, which are a marker of type II pneumocyte maturity.
CL:4040003.label: fetal pre-type II pulmonary alveolar epithelial cell

CL:4042003.definition: A central nervous system macrophage that is part of a choroid plexus, a meninx and a perivascular space. A border associated macrophage interacts with various components of the CNS vasculature and meninges, it participates in immune surveillance and in the regulation of the blood brain barrier.
CL:4042003.label: border associated macrophage

CL:4042039.definition: A neuron of the central nervous system that develops from a caudal ganglionic eminence.
CL:4042039.label: caudal ganglionic eminence derived neuron

CL:4047017.definition: A transit amplifying cell of the gut epithelium, located in the wall of the intestinal crypt, just above intestinal stem cells from which they derive. These are rapidly dividing cells, capable of multiple rounds of division before differentiating into the various cell types of the gut epithelium (enterocyte, goblet, eneterodendocrine, paneth cells).
CL:4047017.label: transit amplifying cell of gut

CL:4047018.definition: An enterocyte that is part of the colon, in the early stages of differentiation, located in the intestinal crypt-villus axis.
CL:4047018.label: early colonocyte

CL:4047019.definition: An enterocyte in the early stages of development, located above the transit-amplifying cell zone in the intestinal crypt-villus axis.
CL:4047019.label: early enterocyte

CL:4047101.definition: A natural killer cell resident to the liver, located in the hepatic sinusoids. In humans this cell type is distinguished from circulating natural killer cells by CD49a or CD69 gene expression. Liver-resident natural killer cells have also been shown to express CCR5, EOMES, KLRB1, GZMK, and CXCR6 in humans.
CL:4047101.label: liver-resident natural killer cell

CL:4052002.definition: A multinucleate cell formed by the fusion of multiple uninuclear cells through plasma membrane fusion. This process leads to a single large cell containing multiple nuclei within a shared cytoplasm.
CL:4052002.label: syncytial cell

CL:4052018.definition: Any epithelial cell that is part of the fallopian tube.
CL:4052018.label: fallopian tube epithelial cell

CL:4052019.definition: Any epithelial cell that is part of the fallopian tube and lacks cilia.
CL:4052019.label: fallopian tube non-ciliated epithelial cell

CL:4052028.definition: A natural killer cell that is part of the uterus, specifically within the endometrium during the non-pregnant state and in the decidua during pregnancy. This cell exhibits dynamic changes in frequency throughout the menstrual cycle, with lower levels during menstruation and a significant increase during the mid-secretory phase and early pregnancy.
CL:4052028.label: uterine natural killer cell

CL:4052030.definition: A fibroblast of the adventitia of a blood vessel. This cell contributes to vascular homeostasis, remodeling, and inflammation by producing extracellular matrix components, cytokines, and growth factors. Adventitial fibroblast can transition into an activated state during injury or disease, marked by increased proliferation, migration, matrix deposition, and contractile protein expression
CL:4052030.label: adventitial fibroblast

CL:4052060.definition: A differentiating keratinocyte found in the epidermis and oral epithelium, located in the stratum spinosum, characterized by a spiny appearance due to abundant intercellular desmosomal junctions.
CL:4052060.label: spinous cell

CL:4052061.definition: A keratinocyte of the skin epidermis that synthesizes keratin and undergoes successive stages of differentiation as it migrates from the basal layer to the cornified (stratum corneum) layer. These differentiation stages include the basal, spinous (prickle), and granular cell layers. This cell is central to epidermal homeostasis, mediating wound healing, immune modulation, including the secretion of cytokines and chemokines that recruit neutrophils (Simmons and Gallo, 2024), and intercellular communication with adjacent melanocytes (Marrapodi and Bellei, 2024).
CL:4052061.label: epidermal keratinocyte

CL:4052108.definition: A class switched memory B cell that lacks IgD on the cell surface.
CL:4052108.label: IgD-negative class switched memory B cell

CL:7770004.definition: An epithelial cell that resides in the layer(s) immediately above the basal layer in stratified or pseudostratified epithelia. This cell mainly originates from basal cells and is found across various tissues, including skin, esophagus, oral mucosa, airway, and cornea.
CL:7770004.label: suprabasal cell

UBERON:0000061.definition: Material anatomical entity that is a single connected structure with inherent 3D shape generated by coordinated expression of the organism's own genome.
UBERON:0000061.label: anatomical structure

UBERON:0001062.definition: Biological entity that is either an individual member of a biological species or constitutes the structural organization of an individual member of a biological species.
UBERON:0001062.label: anatomical entity

UBERON:0004121.definition: An anatomical structure that develops (entirely or partially) from the ectoderm.
UBERON:0004121.label: ectoderm-derived structure

UBERON:0000001.definition: Anatomical structure that is part of a multicellular organism and is at the gross anatomical level, e.g. above the level of a cell.  Included are portions of organism substances such as blood, multi-cell-part structures such as axon tracts, acellular anatomical structures such as hair, and organism subdivisions such as head. Excluded is the whole organism and more granular parts of the organism, such as atoms, molecules, macromolecular complexes and cells.
UBERON:0000001.label: gross anatomical part

UBERON:0000004.definition: The olfactory organ of vertebrates, consisting of nares, olfactory epithelia and the structures and skeletal framework of the nasal cavity.
UBERON:0000004.label: nose

UBERON:0000020.definition: An organ that is capable of transducing sensory stimulus to the nervous system.
UBERON:0000020.label: sense organ

UBERON:0000025.definition: Any hollow cylindrical anatomical structure containing a lumen through which substances are transported.
UBERON:0000025.label: tube

UBERON:0000026.definition: Major subdivision of an organism that protrudes from the body[DOS, CARO].
UBERON:0000026.label: appendage

UBERON:0000029.definition: Any of the rounded masses of lymphoid tissue that are surrounded by a capsule of connective tissue, are distributed along the lymphatic vessels, and contain numerous lymphocytes which filter the flow of lymph.
UBERON:0000029.label: lymph node

UBERON:0000030.definition: A thin layer of loose connective tissue which lies beneath the epithelium and together with the epithelium constitutes the mucosa[WP]. The lamina propria contains capillaries and a central lacteal (lymph vessel) in the small intestine, as well as lymphoid tissue. Lamina propria also contains glands with the ducts opening on to the mucosal epithelium, that secrete mucus and serous secretions.
UBERON:0000030.label: lamina propria

UBERON:0000033.definition: The head is the anterior-most division of the body [GO].
UBERON:0000033.label: head

UBERON:0000042.definition: Multi-tissue structure that is comprised of a secretory epithelial layer (mesothelium) and a connective tissue layer.
UBERON:0000042.label: serous membrane

UBERON:0000043.definition: Dense regular connective tissue that connects muscle to bone[VSAO].
UBERON:0000043.label: tendon

UBERON:0000056.definition: Muscular duct that propels urine from the kidneys to the urinary bladder, or related organs.
UBERON:0000056.label: ureter

UBERON:0000059.definition: A subdivision of the digestive tract that connects the small intestine to the cloaca or anus. Lacks or has few villi[Kardong].
UBERON:0000059.label: large intestine

UBERON:0000061.definition: Material anatomical entity that is a single connected structure with inherent 3D shape generated by coordinated expression of the organism's own genome.
UBERON:0000061.label: anatomical structure

UBERON:0000062.definition: Anatomical structure that performs a specific function or group of functions [WP].
UBERON:0000062.label: organ

UBERON:0000064.definition: A multicellular structure that is a part of an organ.
UBERON:0000064.label: organ part

UBERON:0000160.definition: Segment of the alimentary canal extending from the stomach to the anus and, in humans and other mammals, consists of two segments, the small intestine and the large intestine.
UBERON:0000160.label: intestine

UBERON:0000171.definition: Organ that functions in gaseous exchange between an organism and its environment. In plants, microorganisms, and many small animals, air or water makes direct contact with the organism's cells or tissue fluids, and the processes of diffusion supply the organism with dioxygen (O2) and remove carbon dioxide (CO2). In larger animals the efficiency of gaseous exchange is improved by specialized respiratory organs, such as lungs and gills, which are ventilated by breathing mechanisms.
UBERON:0000171.label: respiration organ

UBERON:0000178.definition: A fluid that is composed of blood plasma and erythrocytes.
UBERON:0000178.label: blood

UBERON:0000179.definition: Circulating fluid that is part of the hemolymphoid system. Blood, lymph, interstitial fluid or its analogs.
UBERON:0000179.label: haemolymphatic fluid

UBERON:0000310.definition: The upper ventral region of the torso of an organism.
UBERON:0000310.label: breast

UBERON:0000344.definition: A lining of mostly endodermal origin, covered in epithelium, which is involved in absorption and secretion. They line various body cavities that are exposed to the external environment and internal organs. It is at several places continuous with skin: at the nostrils, the lips, the ears, the genital area, and the anus. The sticky, thick fluid secreted by the mucous membranes and gland is termed mucus. The term mucous membrane refers to where they are found in the body and not every mucous membrane secretes mucus[WP].
UBERON:0000344.label: mucosa

UBERON:0000403.definition: The outer covering of the calvaria. It is composed of several layers: SKIN; subcutaneous connective tissue; the occipitofrontal muscle which includes the tendonous galea aponeurotica; Loose connective tissue; and the pericranium (the PERIOSTEUM of the SKULL).
UBERON:0000403.label: scalp

UBERON:0000456.definition: A portion of organism substance that is produced by exocrine glands.
UBERON:0000456.label: secretion of exocrine gland

UBERON:0000463.definition: Material anatomical entity in a gaseous, liquid, semisolid or solid state; produced by anatomical structures or derived from inhaled and ingested substances that have been modified by anatomical structures as they pass through the body.
UBERON:0000463.label: organism substance

UBERON:0000467.definition: Multicellular, connected anatomical structure that has multiple organs as parts and whose parts work together to achieve some shared function.
UBERON:0000467.label: anatomical system

UBERON:0000468.definition: Anatomical structure that is an individual member of a species and consists of more than one cell.
UBERON:0000468.label: multicellular organism

UBERON:0000473.definition: A gonad of a male animal. A gonad produces and releases sperm.
UBERON:0000473.label: testis

UBERON:0000475.definition: Anatomical structure which is a subdivision of a whole organism, consisting of components of multiple anatomical systems, largely surrounded by a contiguous region of integument.
UBERON:0000475.label: organism subdivision

UBERON:0000477.definition: Anatomical group whose component anatomical structures lie in close proximity to each other.
UBERON:0000477.label: anatomical cluster

UBERON:0000479.definition: Multicellular anatomical structure that consists of many cells of one or a few types, arranged in an extracellular matrix such that their long-range organisation is at least partly a repetition of their short-range organisation.
UBERON:0000479.label: tissue

UBERON:0000481.definition: Anatomical structure that has as its parts two or more portions of tissue of at least two different types and which through specific morphogenetic processes forms a single distinct structural unit demarcated by bona-fide boundaries from other distinct structural units of different types.
UBERON:0000481.label: multi-tissue structure

UBERON:0000483.definition: Portion of tissue, that consists of one or more layers of epithelial cells connected to each other by cell junctions and which is underlain by a basal lamina. Examples: simple squamous epithelium, glandular cuboidal epithelium, transitional epithelium, myoepithelium[CARO].
UBERON:0000483.label: epithelium

UBERON:0000489.definition: Compound organ that contains one or more macroscopic anatomical spaces.
UBERON:0000489.label: cavitated compound organ

UBERON:0000922.definition: Anatomical entity that comprises the organism in the early stages of growth and differentiation that are characterized by cleavage, the laying down of fundamental tissues, and the formation of primitive organs and organ systems. For example, for mammals, the process would begin with zygote formation and end with birth. For insects, the process would begin at zygote formation and end with larval hatching. For plant zygotic embryos, this would be from zygote formation to the end of seed dormancy. For plant vegetative embryos, this would be from the initial determination of the cell or group of cells to form an embryo until the point when the embryo becomes independent of the parent plant.
UBERON:0000922.label: embryo

UBERON:0000945.definition: An expanded region of the vertebrate alimentary tract that serves as a food storage compartment and digestive organ. A stomach is lined, in whole or in part by a glandular epithelium.
UBERON:0000945.label: stomach

UBERON:0000948.definition: A myogenic muscular circulatory organ found in the vertebrate cardiovascular system composed of chambers of cardiac muscle. It is the primary circulatory organ.
UBERON:0000948.label: heart

UBERON:0000955.definition: The brain is the center of the nervous system in all vertebrate, and most invertebrate, animals. Some primitive animals such as jellyfish and starfish have a decentralized nervous system without a brain, while sponges lack any nervous system at all. In vertebrates, the brain is located in the head, protected by the skull and close to the primary sensory apparatus of vision, hearing, balance, taste, and smell[WP].
UBERON:0000955.label: brain

UBERON:0000977.definition: The invaginated serous membrane that surrounds the lungs (the visceral portion) and lines the walls of the pleural cavity (parietal portion).
UBERON:0000977.label: pleura

UBERON:0000991.definition: Reproductive organ that produces and releases eggs (ovary) or sperm (testis).
UBERON:0000991.label: gonad

UBERON:0000992.definition: The gonad of a female organism which contains germ cells.
UBERON:0000992.label: ovary

UBERON:0000995.definition: The female muscular organ of gestation in which the developing embryo or fetus is nourished until birth.
UBERON:0000995.label: uterus

UBERON:0001013.definition: Portion of connective tissue composed of adipocytes enmeshed in areolar tissue.
UBERON:0001013.label: adipose tissue

UBERON:0001015.definition: A subdivision of the muscular system corresponding to a subdisivision of an organism.
UBERON:0001015.label: musculature

UBERON:0001016.definition: The nervous system is an organ system containing predominantly neuron and glial cells. In bilaterally symmetrical organism, it is arranged in a network of tree-like structures connected to a central body. The main functions of the nervous system are to regulate and control body functions, and to receive sensory input, process this information, and generate behavior [CUMBO].
UBERON:0001016.label: nervous system

UBERON:0001032.definition: Anatomical system that overlaps the nervous system and is responsible for receiving and processing sensory information.
UBERON:0001032.label: sensory system

UBERON:0001040.definition: A sac-like expansion of the ventral wall of the intestine, narrowed into a yolk stalk near the body[Hyman's]. Membranous sac attached to an embryo, providing early nourishment in the form of yolk in bony fishes, sharks, reptiles, birds, and primitive mammals. It functions as the developmental circulatory system of the human embryo, before internal circulation begins. In the mouse, the yolk sac is the first site of blood formation, generating primitive macrophages and erythrocytes[WP].
UBERON:0001040.label: yolk sac

UBERON:0001043.definition: Tube that connects the pharynx to the stomach. In mammals, the oesophagus connects the buccal cavity with the stomach. The stratified squamous non-keratinised epithelium lining the buccal cavity is continued through the pharynx down into the oesophagus. The lowest part of the oesophagus (ca. 2 cm) is lined with gastric mucosa and covered by peritoneum. The main body of the oesophagus is lined with small, simple mucous glands. Each gland opens into the lumen by a long duct which pierces the muscularis mucosae (Wilson and Washington, 1989). A sphincter is situated at the point where the oesophagus enters the stomach to prevent gastro-oesophageal reflux, i.e. to prevent acidic gastric contents from reaching stratified epithelia of the oesophagus, where they can cause inflammation and irritation (Wilson and Washington, 1989; Brown et al., 1993).
UBERON:0001043.label: esophagus

UBERON:0001062.definition: Biological entity that is either an individual member of a biological species or constitutes the structural organization of an individual member of a biological species.
UBERON:0001062.label: anatomical entity

UBERON:0001155.definition: A portion of the large intestine before it becomes the rectum. In mammals, the colon is the most part of the large intestine, excluding the vermiform appendix, the rectum and the anal canal.
UBERON:0001155.label: colon

UBERON:0001255.definition: Distensible musculomembranous organ situated in the anterior part of the pelvic cavity in which urine collects before excretion[MP].
UBERON:0001255.label: urinary bladder

UBERON:0001264.definition: An endoderm derived structure that produces precursors of digestive enzymes and blood glucose regulating hormones[GO].
UBERON:0001264.label: pancreas

UBERON:0001723.definition: A muscular organ in the floor of the mouth.
UBERON:0001723.label: tongue

UBERON:0001913.definition: An emulsion of fat globules within a fluid that is secreted by the mammary gland during lactation.
UBERON:0001913.label: milk

UBERON:0001987.definition: Organ of metabolic interchange between fetus and mother, partly of embryonic origin and partly of maternal origin[GO]. The fetal portion of the placenta is known as the villous chorion. The maternal portion is known as the decidua basalis. The two portions are held together by anchoring villi that are anchored to the decidua basalis by the cytotrophoblastic shell.
UBERON:0001987.label: placenta

UBERON:0002048.definition: Respiration organ that develops as an outpocketing of the esophagus.
UBERON:0002048.label: lung

UBERON:0002049.definition: An interconnected tubular multi-tissue structure contains fluid that is actively transported around the organism[ZFA]. Examples: vasculature of lung, vasculature of face.
UBERON:0002049.label: vasculature

UBERON:0002075.definition: An organ that is located within the body cavity (or in its extension, in the scrotum); it consists of organ parts that are embryologically derived from endoderm, splanchnic mesoderm or intermediate mesoderm; together with other organs, the viscus constitutes the respiratory, gastrointestinal, urinary, reproductive and immune systems, or is the central organ of the cardiovascular system. Examples: heart, lung, esophagus, kidney, ovary, spleen.
UBERON:0002075.label: viscus

UBERON:0002097.definition: The organ covering the body that consists of the dermis and epidermis.
UBERON:0002097.label: skin of body

UBERON:0002101.definition: A paired appendage that is evolved from a paired fin. The extent of this structure includes autopod, stylopod and zeugopod regions when present, but excludes the girdle and its parts.
UBERON:0002101.label: limb

UBERON:0002102.definition: A (free) limb that is connected to a pectoral girdle. The extent of this structure includes autopod, stylopod and zeugopod regions when present, but excludes the pectoral girdle and its parts.
UBERON:0002102.label: forelimb

UBERON:0002103.definition: A (free) limb that is connected to a pelvic girdle region. The extent of this structure includes autopod, stylopod and zeugopod regions when present, but excludes the pelvic girdle and its parts.
UBERON:0002103.label: hindlimb

UBERON:0002106.definition: The organ that functions to filter blood and to store red corpuscles and platelets.
UBERON:0002106.label: spleen

UBERON:0002107.definition: An exocrine gland which secretes bile and functions in metabolism of protein and carbohydrate and fat, synthesizes substances involved in the clotting of the blood, synthesizes vitamin A, detoxifies poisonous substances, stores glycogen, and breaks down worn-out erythrocytes[GO].
UBERON:0002107.label: liver

UBERON:0002108.definition: Subdivision of digestive tract that connects the stomach to the large intestine and is where much of the digestion and absorption of food takes place (with the exception of ruminants). The mammalian small intestine is long and coiled and can be differentiated histologically into: duodenum, jejunem, ileum[WP,cjm,Kardong].
UBERON:0002108.label: small intestine

UBERON:0002110.definition: An organ that aids digestion and stores bile produced by the liver[WP].
UBERON:0002110.label: gallbladder

UBERON:0002113.definition: A paired organ of the urinary tract that produces urine and maintains bodily fluid homeostasis, blood pressure, pH levels, red blood cell production and skeleton mineralization.
UBERON:0002113.label: kidney

UBERON:0002240.definition: Part of the central nervous system located in the vertebral canal continuous with and caudal to the brain; demarcated from brain by plane of foramen magnum. It is composed of an inner core of gray matter in which nerve cells predominate, and an outer layer of white matter in which myelinated nerve fibers predominate, and surrounds the central canal. (CUMBO).
UBERON:0002240.label: spinal cord

UBERON:0002268.definition: An organ that houses olfactory neurons and is responsible for the sense of smell. Examples include the vertebrate nose and the Drosophila dorsal organ.
UBERON:0002268.label: olfactory organ

UBERON:0002365.definition: A gland that secretes products (excluding hormones and other chemical messengers) into ducts (duct glands) which lead directly into the external environment[WP]. Typical exocrine glands include sweat glands, salivary glands, mammary glands, stomach, liver, pancreas.
UBERON:0002365.label: exocrine gland

UBERON:0002367.definition: The prostate gland is a partly muscular, partly glandular body that is situated near the base of the mammalian male urethra and secretes an alkaline viscid fluid which is a major constituent of the ejaculatory fluid.
UBERON:0002367.label: prostate gland

UBERON:0002368.definition: Endocrine glands are glands of the endocrine system that secrete their products directly into the circulatory system rather than through a duct.[WP, modified].
UBERON:0002368.label: endocrine gland

UBERON:0002369.definition: Either of a pair of complex endocrine organs near the anterior medial border of the kidney consisting of a mesodermal cortex that produces glucocorticoid, mineralocorticoid, and androgenic hormones and an ectodermal medulla that produces epinephrine and norepinephrine[BTO].
UBERON:0002369.label: adrenal gland

UBERON:0002371.definition: The soft tissue that fills the cavities of bones.
UBERON:0002371.label: bone marrow

UBERON:0002384.definition: Tissue with cells that deposit non-polarized extracellular matrix including connective tissue fibers and ground substance.
UBERON:0002384.label: connective tissue

UBERON:0002530.definition: An organ that functions as a secretory or excretory organ.
UBERON:0002530.label: gland

UBERON:0003103.definition: Anatomical structure that has as its parts two or more multi-tissue structures of at least two different types and which through specific morphogenetic processes forms a single distinct structural unit demarcated by bona fide boundaries from other distinct anatomical structures of different types.
UBERON:0003103.label: compound organ

UBERON:0003134.definition: A female organ involved in reproduction.
UBERON:0003134.label: female reproductive organ

UBERON:0003135.definition: A male organ involved in reproduction.
UBERON:0003135.label: male reproductive organ

UBERON:0003688.definition: A fold of peritoneum originating at the stomach and supporting the viscera.
UBERON:0003688.label: omentum

UBERON:0003889.definition: Initial section of the oviduct through which the ova pass from the ovary to the uterus.
UBERON:0003889.label: fallopian tube

UBERON:0003914.definition: Epithelial tubes transport gases, liquids and cells from one site to another and form the basic structure of many organs and tissues, with tube shape and organization varying from the single-celled excretory organ in Caenorhabditis elegans to the branching trees of the mammalian kidney and insect tracheal system.
UBERON:0003914.label: epithelial tube

UBERON:0003937.definition: Any of the organized aggregations of cells that function as secretory or excretory organs and are associated with reproduction.
UBERON:0003937.label: reproductive gland

UBERON:0004111.definition: Any tube, opening or passage that connects two distinct anatomical spaces.
UBERON:0004111.label: anatomical conduit

UBERON:0004119.definition: An anatomical structure that develops (entirely or partially) from the endoderm.
UBERON:0004119.label: endoderm-derived structure

UBERON:0004120.definition: An anatomical structure that develops (entirely or partially) from the mesoderm.
UBERON:0004120.label: mesoderm-derived structure

UBERON:0004121.definition: An anatomical structure that develops (entirely or partially) from the ectoderm.
UBERON:0004121.label: ectoderm-derived structure

UBERON:0004177.definition: Organ that is part of the hematopoietic system.
UBERON:0004177.label: hemopoietic organ

UBERON:0004708.definition: An appendage that is part of an appendage girdle complex.
UBERON:0004708.label: paired limb/fin

UBERON:0004709.definition: Paired appendage that consists of the posterior appendicular skeleton and associated soft and hard tissues, but excludes the pelvic girdle and its associated soft and hard tissues.
UBERON:0004709.label: pelvic appendage

UBERON:0004710.definition: Paired appendage that consists of the anterior appendicular skeleton and associated soft and hard tissues, but excludes the pectoral girdle and its associated soft and hard tissues.
UBERON:0004710.label: pectoral appendage

UBERON:0004921.definition: A proximal-distal subdivision of the digestive tract.
UBERON:0004921.label: subdivision of digestive tract

UBERON:0004923.definition: A part of a wall of an organ that forms a layer.
UBERON:0004923.label: organ component layer

UBERON:0005057.definition: An organ that is part of a immune system [Automatically generated definition].
UBERON:0005057.label: immune organ

UBERON:0005156.definition: Any anatomical structure that is part of the reproductive system.
UBERON:0005156.label: reproductive structure

UBERON:0005172.definition: An organ or element that is in the abdomen. Examples: spleen, intestine, kidney, abdominal mammary gland.
UBERON:0005172.label: abdomen element

UBERON:0005173.definition: An organ or element that is part of the adbominal segment of the organism. This region can be further subdivided into the abdominal cavity and the pelvic region.
UBERON:0005173.label: abdominal segment element

UBERON:0005174.definition: An organ or element that part of the dorsum of the organism. Examples: spinal cord, vertebrae, muscles of back.
UBERON:0005174.label: dorsal region element

UBERON:0005177.definition: An organ or element that part of the trunk region. The trunk region can be further subdividied into thoracic (including chest and thoracic cavity) and abdominal (including abdomen and pelbis) regions.
UBERON:0005177.label: trunk region element

UBERON:0005178.definition: An organ or element that is in the thoracic cavity. Examples: lung, heart, longus colli.
UBERON:0005178.label: thoracic cavity element

UBERON:0005179.definition: An organ or element that is part of the pelvic region. Examples: reproductive organs (in some organisms), urinary bladder, bones of the pelvis.
UBERON:0005179.label: pelvic region element

UBERON:0005181.definition: An organ that part of the thoracic segment region. This region can be further subdividied chest and thoracic cavity regions.
UBERON:0005181.label: thoracic segment organ

UBERON:0005292.definition: Portion of tissue that is contiguous with the embryo and is comprised of portions of tissue or cells that will not contribute to the embryo.
UBERON:0005292.label: extraembryonic tissue

UBERON:0005399.definition: A sex gland that is part of a male reproductive system.
UBERON:0005399.label: male reproductive gland

UBERON:0005631.definition: Intrinsic membrane that arises from embryonic germ layers and grow to surround the developing embryo.
UBERON:0005631.label: extraembryonic membrane

UBERON:0006314.definition: Liquid components of living organisms. includes fluids that are excreted or secreted from the body as well as body water that normally is not.
UBERON:0006314.label: bodily fluid

UBERON:0006539.definition: A substance that is secreted by a mammary gland. The substance may differ depending on phase, with colostrum produced during pregancy/early lactation, and milk produced afterwards.
UBERON:0006539.label: mammary gland fluid/secretion

UBERON:0006555.definition: A tube that is part of a excretory system.
UBERON:0006555.label: excretory tube

UBERON:0006858.definition: This gland can either be a discrete structure located bilaterally above each kidney, or a cluster of cells in the head kidney that perform the functions of the adrenal gland. In either case, this organ consists of two cells types, aminergic chromaffin cells and steroidogenic cortical cells[GO].
UBERON:0006858.label: adrenal/interrenal gland

UBERON:0006925.definition: Any gland that is part of the digestive system.
UBERON:0006925.label: digestive system gland

UBERON:0007100.definition: A hollow, muscular organ, which, by contracting rhythmically, keeps up the circulation of the blood or analogs[GO,modified].
UBERON:0007100.label: primary circulatory organ

UBERON:0007499.definition: An epithelial tube that is open at one end only.
UBERON:0007499.label: epithelial sac

UBERON:0007650.definition: The junction between the esophagus and the stomach epithelium.
UBERON:0007650.label: esophagogastric junction

UBERON:0007651.definition: An anatomical structure that connects two structures.
UBERON:0007651.label: anatomical junction

UBERON:0007845.definition: Connective tissue, which consists of fibroblasts, the intercellular matrix of which contains a regular network of collagen and elastic fiber bundles. Examples: bone (tissue), cartilage (tissue), dense regular connective tissue.
UBERON:0007845.label: regular connective tissue

UBERON:0007846.definition: Connective tissue that is dominated by collagen fibres organized into a definitive pattern (e.g., parallel to one another), with comparatively fewer cells (mostly fibroblasts).
UBERON:0007846.label: dense regular connective tissue

UBERON:0010000.definition: An anatomical structure that has more than one cell as a part.
UBERON:0010000.label: multicellular anatomical structure

UBERON:0010039.definition: An organ of the digestive tract that is capable of retaining and storing food.
UBERON:0010039.label: food storage organ

UBERON:0010147.definition: Any gland, other than the gonad, associated with the genital tract, such as the ampulla of the ductus deferens and the bulbourethral, prostate and vesicular glands of the male.
UBERON:0010147.label: male accessory sex gland

UBERON:0010314.definition: An anatomical structure that has some part that develops from the neural crest.
UBERON:0010314.label: structure with developmental contribution from neural crest

UBERON:0011216.definition: A subdivision of an anatomical system.
UBERON:0011216.label: organ system subdivision

UBERON:0011676.definition: A major subdivision of an organism that divides an organism along its main body axis (typically anterio-posterior axis). In vertebrates, this is based on the vertebral column.
UBERON:0011676.label: subdivision of organism along main body axis

UBERON:0011821.definition: Connective tissue, which consists of a population of connective tissue cells, the intercellular matrix of which contains an irregular network of collagen and elastic fiber bundles. Examples: areolar tissue, mucoid tissue, connective tissue of peritoneum, connective tissue of fibrous pericardium.
UBERON:0011821.label: irregular connective tissue

UBERON:0011822.definition: Irregular connective tissue is an irregular connective tissue, the intercellular matrix of which contains a dense irregular network of collagen and elastic fiber bundles. Examples: connective tissue of peritoneum, connective tissue of fibrous pericardium.
UBERON:0011822.label: dense irregular connective tissue

UBERON:0011823.definition: Dense connective tissue is mainly composed of collagen type I. Crowded between the collagen fibers are rows of fibroblasts, fiber-forming cells, that manufacture the fibers. Dense connective tissue forms strong, rope-like structures such as tendons and ligaments. Tendons attach skeletal muscles to bones; ligaments connect bones to bones at joints. Ligaments are more stretchy and contain more elastic fibers than tendons. Dense connective tissue also make up the lower layers of the skin (dermis), where it is arranged in sheets.
UBERON:0011823.label: dense connective tissue

UBERON:0013515.definition: A section through the tube or network of tubes that connects the ovaries to the outside of the body.
UBERON:0013515.label: subdivision of oviduct

UBERON:0013765.definition: Any of the organs or elements that are part of the digestive system. Examples: tongue, esophagus, spleen, crop, lunge feeding organ, tooth elements.
UBERON:0013765.label: digestive system element

UBERON:0015203.definition: An anatomical group whose component structures share a common function.
UBERON:0015203.label: non-connected functional system

UBERON:0015212.definition: Any structure that is placed on one side of the left-right axis of a bilaterian.
UBERON:0015212.label: lateral structure

UBERON:0015228.definition: A hollow, muscular organ, which, by contracting rhythmically, contributes to the circulation of lymph, blood or analogs. Examples: a chambered vertebrate heart; the tubular peristaltic heart of ascidians; the dorsal vessel of an insect; the lymoh heart of a reptile.
UBERON:0015228.label: circulatory organ

UBERON:0017672.definition: A viscus that is part of a abdomen.
UBERON:0017672.label: abdominal viscera

UBERON:0018707.definition: A membranous sac in animals that serves as the receptacle of a liquid or contains gas.
UBERON:0018707.label: bladder organ

UBERON:0034921.definition: An multicellular anatomical structure that has subparts of multiple organs as a part.
UBERON:0034921.label: multi organ part structure

UBERON:0034923.definition: Material anatomical entity consisting of multiple anatomical structures that are not connected to each other.
UBERON:0034923.label: disconnected anatomical group

UBERON:0034929.definition: A region or zone on the surface of an organism that encompasses skin and any adnexa, down through muscles and bounded by underlying skeletal support structures.
UBERON:0034929.label: external soft tissue zone

UBERON:1100000.definition: An anatomical junction between two parts of the digestive tract.
UBERON:1100000.label: digestive tract junction

UBERON:8480009.definition: A tendon that attaches to a semitendinosus.
UBERON:8480009.label: tendon of semitendinosus
